## RWB-E1-032 Automatic attach from the OCR intake

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-032 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-12 Attach an OCR-read document to its case automatically |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-007 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.5; Business Requirements Program, section 5.5 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-024, RWB-E1-050, RWB-E1-053 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **case owner (RW-CASEOWN)**, I want **documents from the OCR intake attached to their case automatically when the case ID or the account number is read, with unmatched or ambiguous documents held for a person who sees the OCR text and the candidate cases and attaches the document**, so that **no document is filed by hand when the case is clear and none is filed on the wrong case when it is not**.

### 2. Business rationale

Scans, partner files and emails arrive without a case link; today a person reads each one and files it. This story matches each classified intake item to one open case by the case ID or the account number in its text and stores it on that case with no person involved (FSD P5 A2.12). An item that matches no case, more than one case, a closed case or no agreed type is held as unmatched, and a person attaches it from the review queue with the OCR text and the candidates in front of them. It meets REQ-DCM-007 and writes the document attached record required from Epic 1 (REQ-DRI-004, RWB-E1-027). The measure is fields extracted without review (FSD P5 A2.12.1).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-024 is done: DocumentStore stores a document and writes the DOCATT decision log entry.
- RWB-E1-050 is done: intake items carry predicted_type, classification_confidence, type_candidates, classifier_version and review_reason.
- RWB-E1-053 is done: the extracted fields case_no and account_no are available for an item where they were read.
- Parameters loaded in document_hub_parameter: CASE_NO_PATTERN = "RW-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{6}", ACCOUNT_NO_PATTERN = "[0-9]{10}" (assumed; DL21) and CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD = 0.80.
- The P3 published interface CaseDirectory returns a case by case number and the open cases for an account number.
- A person resolving unmatched items holds Documents C; items with no candidate are visible only to roles with scope ALL.
- Feature flag rwb.dochub.autoattach is on.

### 4. Flow

1. JOB-12 Document intake: runs matchStep after the extraction step.
2. MatchStep: selects intake items with ocr_status DONE, match_status PENDING, no document_id and a predicted type (review_reason empty or LOW_CONFIDENCE), locking each row; items with review_reason UNKNOWN_TYPE or MODEL_UNAVAILABLE get match_status NO_TYPE and are held for a person.
3. CaseMatcher: collects case numbers from the extracted field case_no and from the OCR text with CASE_NO_PATTERN, and account numbers from the extracted field account_no and the text with ACCOUNT_NO_PATTERN.
4. CaseMatcher: resolves each case number with CaseDirectory.findByCaseNo and each account number with CaseDirectory.findOpenCasesByAccountNo, and returns one of MATCHED, NO_MATCH, MULTIPLE, CONFLICT or CASE_CLOSED with the candidates.
5. MatchStep: for MATCHED, calls DocumentStore.store with the case ID, predicted_type, the intake source, the file, its hash and the extracted fields; the store writes the DOCATT entry with the classifier version, the confidence and the match method, the document row and DocumentStored.
6. MatchStep: on the stored document sets classification_confidence, document_type and type_candidates; for review_reason LOW_CONFIDENCE sets review_status PENDING and write_once false, so it is held in rwb-docs and listed on SCR-31 (RWB-E1-054).
7. MatchStep: sets the intake item match_status MATCHED, case_id and document_id; for any other result sets match_status to the result and candidate_case_ids, and the item is held for a person.
8. Reviewer: opens the Unmatched list on SCR-31 (GET /intake-items), opens an item to see the scan, the OCR text and the candidates, picks the case and the type, and attaches it (POST /intake-items/{intakeItemId}/attach).
9. ManualAttachService: checks the case is in the reviewer's scope and the type is in force, calls DocumentStore.store with the reviewer as approver on the DOCATT entry, and sets the item match_status MATCHED.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | No readable case ID or account number | Item held, match_status NO_MATCH, OCR text held for the reviewer | MSG-P5-003 | AC2 |
| X2 | The account number matches two or more open cases | Item held, match_status MULTIPLE, every candidate offered | MSG-P5-003 | AC3 |
| X3 | The case ID and the account point to different cases | Item held, match_status CONFLICT, both cases offered | MSG-P5-003 | AC5 |
| X4 | A case ID is read that does not exist | No candidate; NO_MATCH | MSG-P5-003 | AC6 |
| X5 | The only candidate case is closed | Item held, match_status CASE_CLOSED | MSG-P5-003 | AC7 |
| X6 | The same file is already on the matched case | The item is linked to the existing document; no second document | None | AC8 |
| X7 | The job runs again over attached items | No second attach, entry or event | None | AC9 |
| X8 | Classification confidence below the threshold and one case matched | Stored with review_status PENDING and write_once false | MSG-P5-003 | AC10 |
| X9 | No agreed type from classification | Item held, match_status NO_TYPE | MSG-P5-003 | AC11 |
| X10 | The reviewer picks a case outside their scope | Refused with 403; item stays held | MSG-P4-003 | AC13 |
| X11 | The reviewer picks a type not in force | Refused with 422 | MSG-P5-006 | AC14 |
| X12 | Two reviewers attach the same item at the same time | The first succeeds; the second gets 409 | MSG-GEN-004 | AC15 |
| X13 | The decision log write fails during an attach | Nothing stored; an automatic attach stays PENDING for the next run; a manual attach returns 503; incident raised (R-UNI-39) | MSG-P7-003 | TC-E1-032-17 (Principle 5) |
| X14 | A role without Documents C attaches an item | Refused with 403 | MSG-P4-002 | TC-E1-032-16 (Access) |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs the store (RWB-E1-024), classification (RWB-E1-050) and extraction (RWB-E1-053), all earlier in Epic 1 |
| Negotiable | The patterns are data; the match outcomes and the reviewer action are fixed by the story |
| Valuable | Ends hand filing for every scan that names its case or account, and gives every other scan one place to be filed |
| Estimable | One job step, one matcher, four endpoints, one list tab |
| Small | Fits within two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion below is one test case in section 16 |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Automatic attach from the OCR intake

  Background:
    Given case "RW-2026-000123" is open, owned by "TEST-CO-01" and linked to account "TEST-ACC-0001"
    Given case "RW-2026-000456" is open and linked to account "TEST-ACC-0002"
    Given case "RW-2026-000789" is closed
    Given parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD is 0.80

  Scenario: AC1 Auto attach

    When intake completes
    Then the system stores the document on case "RW-2026-000123" with type "COURT_NOTICE", source "SCAN", classification_confidence 0.9300 and review_status "NOT_NEEDED" without a person
    Then one decision log entry "DOCATT" holds model version "CLS-1.0", confidence 0.93 and match method "CASE_ID"
    Then the system writes documentStored and the intake item has match_status "MATCHED" and the document ID

  Scenario: AC2 No match

    When intake completes

  Scenario: AC3 Two candidates

  Scenario: AC4 Match by account number

    When intake completes

    Then the decision log entry holds match method "ACCOUNT_NO"

  Scenario: AC5 Case ID and account disagree
    Given a scan with the case ID "RW-2026-000123" and the account number "TEST-ACC-0002"
    When intake completes
    Then the intake item has match_status "CONFLICT" and candidates "RW-2026-000123" and "RW-2026-000456"

  Scenario: AC6 Case ID that does not exist
    Given a scan with the case ID "RW-2026-999999" and no account number
    When intake completes
    Then the intake item has match_status "NO_MATCH"

  Scenario: AC7 Only candidate is closed
    Given a scan with the case ID "RW-2026-000789"
    When intake completes
    Then the intake item has match_status "CASE_CLOSED" and candidate "RW-2026-000789"
    Then the system writes no document row

  Scenario: AC8 The same file is already on the case
    Given the court notice from AC1 is stored on case "RW-2026-000123"
    Given a second intake item holds the same file with the same hash
    When intake completes
    Then the second item has match_status "MATCHED" and the document ID from AC1
    Then the case holds one copy of that court notice and one "DOCATT" entry for it

  Scenario: AC9 Repeat run
    Given 15 intake items already "MATCHED"
    When JOB-12 runs again
    Then no further document row, decision log entry or DocumentStored event is written for them

  Scenario: AC10 Low classification confidence with one case
    Given a scan with the case ID "RW-2026-000123" classified "APPRAISAL_REPORT" at 0.62 with candidates APPRAISAL_REPORT 0.62 and TITLE_DEED 0.30
    When intake completes
    Then the system stores the document on case "RW-2026-000123" with review_status "PENDING", write_once false and the file in "rwb-docs"
    Then the document carries document_type "APPRAISAL_REPORT" and both candidates for SCR-31

  Scenario: AC11 No agreed type
    Given a scan with the case ID "RW-2026-000123" and review_reason "UNKNOWN_TYPE" from classification
    When intake completes

  Scenario: AC12 A reviewer attaches an unmatched item
    Given the item from AC3 and reviewer "TEST-LIT-01" holding RW-LITOFF with both candidate cases in scope
    When "TEST-LIT-01" attaches it to "RW-2026-000654" with type "GUARANTOR_NOTICE"
    Then the system stores the document on "RW-2026-000654" with type "GUARANTOR_NOTICE"
    Then the "DOCATT" entry names "TEST-LIT-01" as approver and match method "PERSON"
    Then the intake item has match_status "MATCHED"

  Scenario: AC13 Reviewer picks a case outside their scope
    Given reviewer "TEST-LIT-02" whose scope does not include case "RW-2026-000654"
    When "TEST-LIT-02" attaches the item from AC3 to "RW-2026-000654"
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-003

  Scenario: AC14 Reviewer picks a type not in force
    Given the item from AC2 and a reviewer with scope ALL
    When the reviewer attaches it to "RW-2026-000123" with type "PAYSLIP"

  Scenario: AC15 Two reviewers attach the same item

```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | A classified document attaches to its case without a person when exactly one open case is found | REQ-DCM-007; FEAT-DCM-12 |
| BR2 | The case is found by the case ID or the account number read from the document; the account number is the join to other systems | DL21; parameters CASE_NO_PATTERN and ACCOUNT_NO_PATTERN in document_hub_parameter (New) |
| BR3 | No match, more than one candidate, disagreement, a closed case or no agreed type goes to a person | REQ-DCM-005; FSD P5 A2.12.4 |
| BR4 | A document classified below the threshold is stored for review in the standard container, not write-once, until a person confirms its type | Parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD in document_hub_parameter (New); RWB-E1-054; CTL-12 |
| BR5 | Each attach is written to the decision log with the classifier version, the confidence and the person where one decided, before the document is stored | Principle 5; R-UNI-39; REQ-DRI-004 |
| BR6 | An item attached once is not attached again | R-UNI-40 |
| BR7 | A reviewer attaches only to a case in their scope | CTL-09 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It changes the intake item match_status: PENDING to MATCHED on an automatic attach; PENDING to NO_MATCH, MULTIPLE, CONFLICT, CASE_CLOSED or NO_TYPE when held for a person; a held value to MATCHED when a reviewer attaches it. It creates a document record (COPY_PENDING, then STORED, in RWB-E1-024).

### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| SY-OCR, OCR and extraction pipeline | Matches and attaches automatically (Documents C) |
| SY-DECLOG, decision log writer | Writes the DOCATT entry |
| Roles with Documents C and the candidate case in scope (for example RW-LITOFF, RW-CASEOWN) | See and attach unmatched items that name a candidate in their scope |
| Roles with Documents C and scope ALL (for example RW-LEGAL) | See and attach unmatched items with no candidate |
| Roles with Documents R only (for example RW-TEAMMGR) | See attached documents on cases in their scope; no attach |

### 12. Contract

**Job**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Trigger | JOB-12 Document intake, step matchStep after the extraction step |
| Job name | JOB-12 Document intake |
| Schedule | Every 15 minutes in business hours |
| Input | Intake items with ocr_status DONE, match_status PENDING, no document_id and a predicted type |
| Output | Documents stored on their case; held items with match status and candidates; counts on the job record |
| Events published | DocumentStored (EV-16), through DocumentStore |
| Idempotency key | Intake item ID, and in the store the case, type and file hash |
| Restart behavior | Items left PENDING are matched in the next run; an attach that failed on the decision log stays PENDING |

**GET /review-items** (new, see additions)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | Query matchStatus (default the held values NO_MATCH, MULTIPLE, CONFLICT, CASE_CLOSED and NO_TYPE), page, size (default 50) |
| Response | 200 IntakeItemPage: items [id, source, receivedAt, matchStatus, predictedType, classificationConfidence, typeCandidates, candidateCases (caseId, caseNo), version], page, size, total; oldest first; only items whose candidates are in scope, and items with no candidate for scope ALL |
| Errors | 401; 403 no Documents R (MSG-P4-002); 503 |
| Authorization | Documents, right R, scope applied |
| Idempotency | Not applicable |

**GET /intake-items/{intakeItemId}** and **GET /intake-items/{intakeItemId}/content** (new, see additions)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | Path intakeItemId |
| Response | 200 IntakeItem with pages [pageNo, text] (personal identifiers masked by role); content returns the file |
| Errors | 401; 403 (MSG-P4-002, MSG-P4-003); 404; 503 |
| Authorization | Documents, right R, scope applied; each read written to the PII access log |
| Idempotency | Not applicable |

**POST /intake-items/{intakeItemId}/resolve** (new, see additions)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | IntakeAttachRequest: caseId (uuid, required), documentType (required), version (integer, required) |
| Response | 201 Document |
| Errors | 401; 403 no Documents C (MSG-P4-002) or case out of scope (MSG-P4-003); 404; 409 item no longer held or version changed (MSG-GEN-004); 422 type not in force (MSG-P5-006) or missing field (MSG-GEN-001); 503 decision log write failed (MSG-P7-003) |
| Authorization | Documents, right C, scope applied to the chosen case |
| Idempotency | Idempotency-Key header; a repeat returns the first result |

**Published interfaces called**

```java
// P3
Optional<CaseSummary> findByCaseNo(String caseNo);                 // id, caseNo, status, ownerUserId
List<CaseSummary> findOpenCasesByAccountNo(String accountNo);
// P5, RWB-E1-024
StoredDocument store(StoreRequest request);                         // request carries approverUserId for a manual attach
```

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** Folder `recovery/dochub/attach`, Java package `recovery.dochub.attach`; front end folder `recovery/documents`.

**Components.**

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| MatchStep | Job | Step of JOB-12: select, match, store or hold for a person |
| CaseMatcher | Service | Reads case numbers and account numbers; resolves them through CaseDirectory; returns the result and candidates |
| MatchPatterns | Rule table | Reads the two pattern parameters from document_hub_parameter |
| AutoAttachService | Service | Builds the StoreRequest with the classification inputs; applies the review rule of BR4; updates the intake item |
| ManualAttachService | Service | Scope and type checks, optimistic lock on the item, store with the approver |
| IntakeItemController | Controller | The four intake item endpoints |
| IntakeItemRepository | Repository | Reads and writes document_intake only (table from RWB-E1-049) |
| UnmatchedIntakeTab | React component | Unmatched list on SCR-31 with the scan viewer, OCR text, candidates, case picker and type picker |

**Database.**
- Flyway migration `V1_5_032__intake_match.sql` adds to document_intake: match_status varchar(12) default 'PENDING', candidate_case_ids jsonb. The document columns document_type and type_candidates come from the RWB-E1-050 migration.
- Index ix_intake_held on document_intake (match_status, received_at) where match_status not in ('PENDING', 'MATCHED').

**Configuration and reference data.**
- Parameters CASE_NO_PATTERN, ACCOUNT_NO_PATTERN and CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD in document_hub_parameter, loaded by the reference data administrator.
- No rule row; the match outcomes are the story's fixed behavior.

**Build steps.**
1. Write the migration; test the columns and the index.
2. Build MatchPatterns and the text scan; unit test pattern reads on synthetic text with Thai and English around the numbers.
3. Build CaseMatcher with the five outcomes against a CaseDirectory stub; unit test AC2 to AC7.
4. Build AutoAttachService with the store call, the review rule and the item update; integration test AC1, AC4, AC8, AC10 and AC11.
5. Build MatchStep selection and skip rules; test AC9.
6. Build IntakeItemController and ManualAttachService; API tests AC12 to AC15 and the access test.
7. Build UnmatchedIntakeTab; component tests for list, detail and attach.
8. Test the decision log failure path for the automatic and the manual attach.

**Feature flag.** `rwb.dochub.autoattach`. Off: matchStep sets every classified item to match_status NO_MATCH, and reviewers attach them by hand.

**Done when.** The tests in section 16 pass and, on the 180 synthetic samples in SIT, every item with one readable case ID and a confidence at or above 0.80 is attached in the same run.

| MSG-P5-003 | Item held for a person or document stored for review | Some fields need checking. The document is in the review queue. |
| MSG-P5-006 | Reviewer picks a type not in force | {value} is not a document type in force. Choose a type from the list. |
| MSG-GEN-001 | Case or type missing on attach | Enter {field}. |
| MSG-GEN-004 | Item attached by someone else | Someone else changed this record. Reload it to see their change. |
| MSG-P7-003 | Decision log write failed | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |
| MSG-P4-002 | Role without the right | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |
| MSG-P4-003 | Chosen case outside the scope | This case is not in your scope. |

Thai text for each message follows decision DL10.

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: the case number and account number patterns and the threshold are parameters.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts: account numbers and OCR text are never logged; logs carry the intake ID and the outcome; test accounts are synthetic.
- No read of another module's tables: cases and accounts are resolved through CaseDirectory.
- The matcher never picks one of several candidates; any doubt goes to a person.
- A document stored for type review is never put in the write-once container before its type is confirmed (RWB-E1-054).

## RWB-E1-033 Search across cases

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-033 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-06 Search documents across cases |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-001, REQ-ACA-006 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, sections 3.5 and 3.4; Business Requirements Program, sections 5.5 and 5.4 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Should |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-024, RWB-E1-053, RWB-E1-049 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **litigation officer (RW-LITOFF)**, I want **a search across all cases in my scope by document type, date range, extracted field and free text, with every search written to the access log**, so that **I find a document in seconds without opening cases one by one, and every look at personal data can be audited**.

### 2. Business rationale

Legal, audit and recovery questions span many cases: every appraisal above a value, every notice from one court, every document naming a guarantor. Today each case folder is opened by hand (FSD P5 A2.6). This story searches the document index, the extracted fields and the OCR text across the cases the user may see, masks personal data the role may not see, and logs each search. It meets REQ-DCM-001 (documents found by their type, date and extracted fields) and REQ-ACA-006 (every read of the document store written to the access log), under control CTL-09 and CTL-11.

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-024 is done: documents and extracted fields are in the index.
- RWB-E1-049 is done: OCR text is in document_text.
- RWB-E1-053 is done: extracted fields carry names from the type table and a confidence.
- Masking rules loaded (DL26). Assumed until Compliance provides them: RW-LITOFF, RW-LEGAL and RW-AUDIT see party names in document text unmasked; every other role sees them masked.
- Parameters loaded in document_hub_parameter: SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS = 1000, SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE = 50, FREE_TEXT_MIN_CHARS = 3, FREE_TEXT_MAX_CHARS = 100 (assumed; DL11).
- The ACE common module writes access events to the PII access log and confirms each write.
- The user holds Documents R. Feature flag rwb.dochub.search is on.

### 4. Flow

1. Litigation officer: opens Document search from the Documents menu and enters a type, a stored date range, a field condition (field, operator, value) and or a free text term.
2. Front end: calls GET /documents with the criteria.
3. DocumentSearchService: validates the criteria: at least one criterion, date order, free text length, field in the type's field list.
4. DocumentSearchService: checks with the masking policy that the role may search a personal field or free text; refuses otherwise.
5. DocumentSearchService: gets the case IDs in the user's scope through CaseDirectory.caseIdsInScope (all cases for scope ALL).
6. DocumentSearchRepository: queries active documents in those cases by type and stored date, joined to document_field for the field condition and to document_text for the free text, newest first, up to SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS.
7. DocumentSearchService: builds each row: case number, document type, stored date, source, the matched field or a text snippet of 60 characters with the term highlighted and other personal identifiers masked.
8. DocumentSearchService: writes the access event DOCUMENT_SEARCH (user, role, criteria with the free text term as a SHA-256 hash, result count, case IDs returned) through the PII access log and waits for the confirmation.
9. Front end: shows the first page of 50 rows; the user opens a row in DocumentDetailPanel (RWB-E1-024).

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | The role's masking rule hides party names and the user searches free text or a personal field | Refused with 422; nothing searched | MSG-P5-020 | AC4 |
| X2 | No criterion entered | Refused with 422 | MSG-GEN-001 | AC5 |
| X3 | Date from after date to | Refused with 422 | MSG-GEN-003 | AC6 |
| X4 | Free text shorter than 3 or longer than 100 characters | Refused with 422 | MSG-GEN-002 | AC7 |
| X5 | More than SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS documents match | The first 1000 by date are returned with a capped flag | MSG-P5-021 | AC8 |
| X6 | The access log write is not confirmed | Results are not returned; 503 | MSG-P5-019 | AC9 |
| X7 | Nothing matches | Empty state | None | AC10 |
| X8 | A role without Documents R searches | Refused with 403 | MSG-P4-002 | TC-E1-033-11 (Access) |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs the index (RWB-E1-024), OCR text (RWB-E1-049) and extracted fields (RWB-E1-053), all earlier in Epic 1 |
| Negotiable | Limits, page size and the masking rules are data; the criteria set can grow |
| Valuable | A cross-case question takes one search instead of opening each case |
| Estimable | One endpoint, one service, one query with two indexes, one page |
| Small | Fits within two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion below is one test case in section 16 |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Search across cases

  Background:
    Given 500 synthetic documents indexed across 120 cases
    Given 60 of them are "APPRAISAL_REPORT", 14 with appraised_value above 5,000,000, 9 of those stored in October 2026
    Given user "TEST-LIT-01" holds RW-LITOFF with scope ALL

  Scenario: AC1 Search by field
    Given "TEST-LIT-01" is on the Document search page

    Then exactly the 9 matching documents list with case number, type, stored date and the field value
    Then the response arrives within 2 seconds

  Scenario: AC2 Role limit

    Given 40 of the 500 documents are on "HIRE_PURCHASE" cases
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | Results hold only active documents on cases in the user's scope | CTL-09; FEAT-DCM-20 |
| BR2 | Personal fields and free text are searchable only by roles that see them unmasked; snippets mask other personal identifiers | CTL-11; DL26; masking rules reference table |
| BR3 | Every search is written to the access log before results are returned; a free text term is logged as a hash | REQ-ACA-006; CTL-11 |
| BR4 | Field conditions use the field names and data types of the type table in force | RWB-E1-025; DL19 |
| BR5 | Result limit, page size and free text length are parameters | Document hub parameter table (New); DL11 |
| BR6 | The date criterion is the stored date of the document in Epic 1 | FSD P5 A2.6 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It writes no record of its own; the access event goes to the PII access log of the ACE common module.

### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| RW-LITOFF, litigation officer | Searches by type, date, field and free text in their scope |
| RW-LEGAL, legal counsel; RW-AUDIT, internal audit | Search across all cases (scope ALL); free text allowed under the assumed masking rule |
| RW-COMPLY, compliance and PDPA officer | Searches by type, date and non-personal fields; reads the access log |
| Other roles with Documents R | Search by type, date and non-personal fields in their scope |
| RW-CAPACITY and other roles without Documents R | No search |

|---|---|---|---|
| DF-CAS-001 | recovery_case | id | Read, through CaseDirectory |
| DF-CAS-002 | recovery_case | case_no | Read, through CaseDirectory |
| DF-DOC-001 | document | id | Read |
| DF-DOC-002 | document | case_id | Read |

| Standard column | document | created_at | Read, as the stored date |

| DF-DOC-014 | document_field | field_name | Read |

Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.

### 12. Contract

**GET /documents** (new, see additions)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | Query: type (doc_type_code), dateFrom, dateTo (date), field (field name), op (eq, gt, lt, between), value, value2, q (free text, 3 to 100 characters), page, size (default 50, maximum 50) |
| Response | 200 DocumentSearchPage: items [documentId, caseId, caseNo, documentType, storedAt, source, matchedField, matchedValue, snippet], page, size, total, capped |
| Errors | 401; 403 no Documents R (MSG-P4-002); 422 no criterion (MSG-GEN-001), date order (MSG-GEN-003), text length (MSG-GEN-002), personal field or free text not allowed (MSG-P5-020); 503 access log not confirmed (MSG-P5-019) or store unavailable (MSG-GEN-006) |
| Authorization | Documents, right R, scope applied |
| Idempotency | Not applicable; each call writes its own access event |

**Published interfaces called**

```java
// P3
Set<UUID> caseIdsInScope(ScopeFilter scope);        // empty filter for scope ALL
Map<UUID, String> caseNumbers(Collection<UUID> caseIds);
// P4
boolean mayReadUnmasked(String roleCode, String fieldClass);   // fieldClass PARTY_NAME, ACCOUNT_NO, ID_NO
```

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** Folder `recovery/dochub/search`, Java package `recovery.dochub.search`; front end folder `recovery/documents`.

**Components.**

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| DocumentHubController | Controller | Adds GET /documents/search |
| DocumentSearchService | Service | Validation, masking check, scope, query, row building, access event |
| DocumentSearchRepository | Repository | One SQL query over document, document_field and document_text, with paging and the cap |
| SnippetBuilder | Service | 60-character snippet, highlight, masking of other identifiers through the ACE PII service |
| DocumentSearchPage | React component | Criteria form, result table with paging, empty and error states |

**Database.**
- Reads document, document_field and document_text. No new table.
- Flyway migration `V1_5_033__document_search_indexes.sql`: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm; GIN index ix_document_text_trgm on document_text using gin (text_content gin_trgm_ops); function dochub_to_numeric(text) returning numeric or null; index ix_document_field_name_num on document_field (field_name, dochub_to_numeric(field_value)); index ix_document_field_name_value on document_field (field_name, field_value).

**Configuration and reference data.**
- SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS, SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE, FREE_TEXT_MIN_CHARS, FREE_TEXT_MAX_CHARS in document_hub_parameter, loaded by the reference data administrator.
- Masking rules (DL26), loaded by the reference data administrator for Compliance.

**Build steps.**
1. Write the migration; test that Thai free text is found with ILIKE through the trigram index.
2. Build criteria validation; unit test AC5, AC6 and AC7.
3. Build the masking check; test AC4.
4. Build the query with scope, paging and the cap; integration test AC1, AC2 and AC8 on the 500-document set.
5. Build SnippetBuilder; test AC3.
6. Add the access event with the hash and the confirmation wait; test AC9 and the event content in AC2.
7. Build DocumentSearchPage with the states; component tests and AC10; performance test of AC1 in SIT.

**Feature flag.** `rwb.dochub.search`. Off: GET /documents/search returns 404 and the menu item is hidden.

**Done when.** The tests in section 16 pass and AC1 answers within 2 seconds at the 95th percentile over 50 runs in SIT.

| MSG-GEN-001 | No criterion | Enter {field}. |
| MSG-GEN-002 | Free text length outside 3 to 100 | {field} must be between {min} and {max}. |
| MSG-GEN-003 | Date from after date to | {field} cannot be before {other}. |
| MSG-P5-019 | Access log write not confirmed | The search was not run because it could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |

| MSG-P4-002 | Role without the right | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: limits, page size, text length and masking are data.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts: the free text term is logged as a hash; names in tests are synthetic.
- No read of another module's tables: scope and case numbers come through CaseDirectory, masking through the P4 interface.
- A result is never returned before its access event is confirmed.

## RWB-E1-034 Letter template management

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-034 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P6 Communications |
| Feature | FEAT-DRI-15 Manage letter templates with Legal approval |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-OCC-002 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, sections 3.6 and 4 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | D7.1 |
| Priority | Should |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-046, RWB-E1-015 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **litigation officer (RW-LITOFF)**, I want **a screen to upload a template version, have Legal counsel record the approval and set it current**, so that **templates are managed without a developer**.

### 2. Business rationale

A template change today needs a person outside Legal to edit a file and send it round, and nothing records which wording was approved. This story gives the litigation officer an upload and Legal counsel an approve and withdraw action on SCR-33 Template approval, with the approver and date held on the version. It serves REQ-OCC-002 and control CTL-14 (every notice from the current Legal-approved version), and removes the developer from template changes.

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-046 is done: the template and merge_field tables, the load checks and the TemplateCatalog interface exist.
- RWB-E1-015 is done: the freshness stamp shows on screens that read data products.
- The merge field catalog is loaded, with codes "CASE_NO", "CUSTOMER_NAME", "POSTAL_ADDRESS", "TOTAL_OUTSTANDING" and "NOTICE_DATE" in the synthetic set.
- The uploader holds RW-LITOFF or RW-LEGAL (Documents C); the approver holds RW-LEGAL (Documents A).
- The ACE storage pattern with a write-once container is available for template bodies (DL27).

### 4. Flow

1. Litigation officer: opens SCR-33 Template approval and chooses the template code and language, or a new code.
2. Litigation officer: uploads the DOCX body and enters product group, channel, notice type, signature basis and the merge codes used.
3. System: checks the role (Documents C), the required fields, the file type and size, and every merge code against the catalog (MergeCodeScanner from RWB-E1-046).
4. System: stores the body write-once, creates the next version number in state Draft and shows it in the list.
5. Legal counsel: opens the Draft version, reads the body and the merge codes, enters the valid from date and approves.
6. System: checks the role (Documents A), that the approver is not the uploader (CTL-05), that the version is Draft and that valid from is not before today; sets state Approved with approver and approval time.
7. System: from valid from, TemplateCatalog returns this version as current; earlier Approved versions stay readable on SCR-33.
8. Legal counsel: may withdraw an Approved version with a reason; the system sets state Withdrawn and generation for that code and language holds (R-LIT-04).
9. System: writes every upload, approval and withdrawal to the ACE audit log with the user, the version and the time.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | Set current is chosen on a version with no approver | Refused; the version stays Draft | MSG-P6-005 | AC2 |
| X2 | The uploader of a version tries to approve it | Refused; the version stays Draft | MSG-P7-002 | AC3 |
| X3 | The body uses a merge code not in the catalog | Upload refused; nothing stored | MSG-P6-006 | AC4 |
| X4 | Template code or language is empty | Upload refused | MSG-GEN-001 | AC5 |
| X5 | The file is not a DOCX file | Upload refused | MSG-P6-010 | AC6 |
| X6 | Valid from is before today | Approval refused | MSG-GEN-003 | AC7 |
| X7 | Legal withdraws the current version | Version Withdrawn; generation holds | MSG-P6-003 | AC8 |
| X8 | Two approvers act on the same version at once | The first wins; the second is refused | MSG-GEN-004 | AC9 |
| X9 | Approve is sent twice with the same Idempotency-Key | The second returns the first result; nothing changes | None | AC10 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs the catalog (RWB-E1-046) only; generation (RWB-E1-052) is separate |
| Negotiable | Layout of SCR-33 follows the ACE components (DL08, DL31); the behavior is fixed here |
| Valuable | Legal approves wording in the Workbench, and the approval is on the version |
| Estimable | Five endpoints, one screen with three states |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion is an API or screen test with synthetic templates |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Letter template management

  Background:
    Given user "LIT-0101" holds RW-LITOFF
    Given user "LEG-0001" holds RW-LEGAL
    Given template "DEMAND-MTG" in language "TH" has version 2 Approved by "LEG-0001" with valid from 2026-11-01
    Given today is 2026-11-20

  Scenario: AC1 New version
    Given "LIT-0101" uploads "demand-mtg-th-v3.docx" for "DEMAND-MTG" "TH" using merge codes "CASE_NO" and "TOTAL_OUTSTANDING"
    Given version 3 is created in state "Draft"
    When "LEG-0001" approves version 3 with valid from 2026-11-20
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | Only an Approved version with an approver and approval time can become current | REQ-OCC-002; CTL-14 |
| BR2 | The person who uploaded a version cannot approve it | CTL-05; roles.txt separation of duty |
| BR3 | Approval needs Documents A, held by Legal counsel | roles.txt permission matrix; DL28 |
| BR4 | Every merge code in the body is in the merge field catalog in force | RWB-E1-046 BR4; Principle 1 |
| BR5 | Valid from is today or later | MSG-GEN-003 rule; refdata.txt change process, step 5 |
| BR6 | A withdrawn version holds generation until a new version is approved; no fallback to an earlier version | R-LIT-04, R-LIT-06 |
| BR7 | Template bodies are stored write-once; a change is a new version | CTL-12; DL27 |
| BR8 | Allowed body file types are a configuration list, DOCX in Epic 1 | Principle 1 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It changes the template version state (standard column state):

| From | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | Upload | Checks pass | Draft |
| Draft | Approve | Approver is Legal counsel and not the uploader; valid from today or later | Approved |
| Approved | Withdraw | Reason entered | Withdrawn |

### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| RW-LITOFF, litigation officer | Uploads a version (Documents C), reads templates (Documents R) |
| RW-LEGAL, Legal counsel | Uploads, approves and withdraws a version (Documents CRUA); cannot approve own upload |
| RW-CASEOWN, RW-TEAMMGR and other roles with Documents R | Read templates on SCR-33 |
| RW-COMPLY, Compliance and PDPA officer | Reads templates (Documents R) |

No approval level from the delegation of authority applies; Legal approval of wording is a Documents A right.

| BR Field ID | Entity | Field | Read or write |

Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.

### 12. Contract

All five endpoints are new and recorded in the additions file. Base path /api/recovery/v1. Errors use the Problem schema.

| Method and path | Request | Response | Errors | Authorization | Idempotency |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET /templates | Query: code, language, state, page, size | 200 TemplatePage (items of Template) | 401, 403, 503 | Documents R, scope applied | Not applicable |
| POST /templates | multipart: file, templateCode, language, productGroup, channel, noticeType, signatureBasis, mergeCodes | 201 Template, state DRAFT | 401; 403 (MSG-P4-002); 413; 415 (MSG-P6-010); 422 (MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P6-006); 503 (MSG-GEN-006) | Documents C | Idempotency-Key header |
| GET /templates/{templateId}/content | None | 200 application/octet-stream | 401, 403, 404, 503 | Documents R | Not applicable |
| POST /templates/{templateId}/approve | TemplateApproval: validFrom | 200 Template, state APPROVED | 401; 403 (MSG-P4-002); 404; 409 not Draft (MSG-P3-005), changed (MSG-GEN-004), own upload (MSG-P7-002); 422 (MSG-GEN-003); 503 | Documents A | Idempotency-Key header |
| POST /templates/{templateId}/withdraw | TemplateWithdrawal: reason | 200 Template, state WITHDRAWN | 401; 403; 404; 409 not Approved (MSG-P3-005); 422 reason empty (MSG-GEN-001); 503 | Documents A | Idempotency-Key header |

Template schema: id, templateCode, templateVersion, language, productGroup, channel, noticeType, signatureBasis, mergeCodes, state, approvedBy, approvedAt, validFrom, createdBy, createdAt, version. 409 MSG-GEN-004 is raised from the optimistic lock on the standard column version.

### 13. Solution plan

- Package: folder `recovery/comms/templates`, Java package `recovery.comms.templates`; front end folder `recovery/comms/templates` in the ACE front end (DL07).

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| TemplateController | Controller | The five endpoints; maps errors to Problem responses |
| TemplateAdminService | Service | Upload, approve, withdraw; applies BR1 to BR8; writes the ACE audit entry |
| TemplateRepository | Repository | From RWB-E1-046; adds the optimistic lock on version |
| TemplateBodyStore | Service | Stores the body write-once through the ACE storage pattern and returns body_ref |
| MergeCodeScanner | Service | From RWB-E1-046; reused for the upload check |
| TemplateApprovalScreen | React component | SCR-33: list by code and language, version detail, upload form, approve and withdraw dialogs |

- Database: reads and writes table template (columns from RWB-E1-046). No new table. The unique constraint uk_template_version from RWB-E1-046 stops a duplicate version number; version numbers are assigned inside a transaction with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the highest version of the code and language.
- Configuration and reference data: property `rwb.comms.template.allowed-types` = DOCX; property `rwb.comms.template.max-size-mb` = 10, assumed; DL11. Merge field catalog loaded by RW-REFADM.
- Build steps:
  1. Add the Template, TemplatePage, TemplateApproval and TemplateWithdrawal schemas to the OpenAPI file and generate the controller interface.
  2. Build the upload path with the type, size, required field and merge code checks; test AC1 (upload part), AC4, AC5, AC6.
  3. Build TemplateBodyStore with write-once storage; test that a second write to the same ref is refused.
  4. Build approve with the role, self-approval, state and valid from checks; test AC1, AC2, AC3, AC7.
  5. Add the optimistic lock and the Idempotency-Key store; test AC9 and AC10.
  6. Build withdraw; test AC8.
  7. Build SCR-33 with states Draft, Approved and Withdrawn, the common Loading and Error states, and the MSG texts in English and Thai; browser test of the upload and approve path.
- Feature flag: `rwb.comms.template-admin`.
- Done when: the tests in section 16 pass, and SCR-33 shows only the actions the signed-in role holds.

|---|---|---|
| MSG-P6-005 | Set current on a version with no Legal approval | {template} version {version} has no Legal approval. It cannot be used. |
| MSG-P7-002 | The uploader approves their own version | You prepared this decision, so you cannot approve it. |
| MSG-P6-006 | A merge code is not in the catalog | {template} uses the merge field {field}, which is not in the merge field catalog. The load was refused. |
| MSG-GEN-001 | A required field is empty | Enter {field}. |
| MSG-P6-010 | The body file type is not allowed | This template file type cannot be loaded. Use {types}. |
| MSG-GEN-003 | Valid from is before today | {field} cannot be before {other}. |
| MSG-P6-003 | A withdrawn template is asked for | The {template} template has been withdrawn. The notice is on hold until Legal approves a new version. |
| MSG-GEN-004 | Another person changed the version first | Someone else changed this record. Reload it to see their change. |
| MSG-P3-005 | Approve on a version that is not Draft, or withdraw on one that is not Approved | This case cannot move to {state} from {current}. |
| MSG-P4-002 | The role lacks the right | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |

| Approved | Everyone with Documents R sees the version, approver, approval time and valid from. Legal counsel sees Withdraw |

The common states Loading and Error apply (screens.txt, common states).

### 17. Guardrails

## RWB-E1-035 Case record view v1.1 with documents and history timeline

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-035 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P3 Case and workflow |
| Feature | FEAT-ACA-12 Show the case record view with the history timeline |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-CWC-016, REQ-OCC-007 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, sections 3.3 and 3.6; Business Requirements Program, sections 5.3 and 5.6 |
| L3 process | 06 Take over and own the case |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Should |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-021, RWB-E1-023, RWB-E1-027 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **case owner (RW-CASEOWN)**, I want **a timeline on the case record view with contacts, documents, assignments, transfers and status changes in time order, each with who or which rule caused it**, so that **I see what happened to the case without asking anyone**.

### 2. Business rationale

A case that changes owner today arrives with no history except what the last owner remembers. This story adds a timeline panel to SCR-03 that merges the interaction ledger, the documents, the assignments and the decision log entries for the case in time order, and shows the person or the rule and version behind each event, including the coded reason of a manual transfer. It meets REQ-CWC-016 (every workflow event carries its rule ID and version, now visible) and REQ-OCC-007 (contact history and documents on the case view).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-023 is done: SCR-03 shows the read-only case record.
- RWB-E1-021 is done: transfers write assignments with a transfer reason and a decision log entry.
- RWB-E1-027 is done: decision log entries can be read by case through the P7 interface.
- The P5 document hub lists documents by case.
- The user holds Case record R and the case is in scope.

### 4. Flow

1. Case owner: opens SCR-03 for case RW-2026-000801 and selects the Timeline panel.
2. TimelinePanel: calls GET /cases/{caseId}/timeline with page 0 and size 50.
3. CaseAndWorkflowController: checks Case record R and the scope.
4. TimelineService: reads interactions and assignments from P3 tables, documents through the P5 interface and decision log entries through the P7 interface, for the case.
5. TimelineService: maps each record to a TimelineItem with time, type, summary, by and reference.
6. TimelineService: sorts by time, then by a fixed type order for equal times, then by record ID, and returns the page with the total.
7. TimelinePanel: shows each item with an icon for its type; "by" shows a person's name, or a rule ID with its version.
8. Case owner: opens a transfer item; the panel shows the transfer reason, the from and to queue and owner, and the rule version.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | The decision log query does not answer | Other events show; the panel shows the section message | MSG-P3-023 | AC3 |
| X2 | The case has only its creation entry | One item "Case created" shows with the entry rule and version | None | AC4 |
| X3 | Two events have the same time | Fixed order by type, then record ID | None | AC5 |
| X4 | The case has more than 50 events | Paged by 50; the total shows | None | AC6 |
| X5 | The case is outside the user's scope | 404 | MSG-P4-003 | AC7 |
| X6 | A role without Case record R opens the timeline | Refused with 403 | MSG-P4-002 | Access test TC-E1-035-08 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Reads records that RWB-E1-018 to RWB-E1-028 write; adds one panel |
| Negotiable | The type order and icons are design choices |
| Valuable | A new owner sees the case history in one place |
| Estimable | One endpoint, one merge service, one panel |
| Small | Fits one week |
| Testable | Every criterion has a test case in section 16 |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Case record view v1.1 with documents and history timeline

  Background:
    Given case owner U-81 owns case RW-2026-000801

  Scenario: AC1 Timeline order
    Given case RW-2026-000801 has a rule transfer at 2026-12-02 08:10 by row "TRF-007" version "TRF-2026.11"
    Given documents "Demand letter" stored at 2026-12-02 10:30 and "Title deed" at 2026-12-03 09:00
    Given a status change from "ASSIGNED" to "IN_PROGRESS" at 2026-12-03 11:15 by U-81
    When the timeline opens
    Then the four events show in the order transfer, demand letter, title deed, status change
    Then the transfer shows "TRF-007" with version "TRF-2026.11" and the status change shows U-81

  Scenario: AC2 Transfer reason
    Given a manual transfer at 2026-12-04 14:00 by team manager U-71 with transfer reason "R04"
    When the event is opened
    Then the reason "R04 Owner absent", the from owner, the to owner and the rule version "TRF-2026.11" are shown

  Scenario: AC3 Decision log unavailable
    Given the decision log query does not answer within 3 seconds
    When the timeline opens
    Then the interactions, documents and assignments show in time order
    Then the panel shows MSG-P3-023 for "Decisions"

  Scenario: AC4 A new case shows only its creation
    Given case RW-2026-000802 was created on 2026-12-02 and its only record is the creation entry in the decision log
    When the timeline opens
    Then one item shows with type "Case created", time 2026-12-02 and the entry rule version

  Scenario: AC5 Events at the same time
    Given an assignment and a decision log entry both at 2026-12-02 07:00:00
    When the timeline opens
    Then the decision log entry shows before the assignment, by the fixed type order
    Then the order is the same on every opening

  Scenario: AC6 More than 50 events
    Given case RW-2026-000803 has 132 events
    When the timeline opens
    Then the first page shows the 50 most recent events and total 132
    Then the third page shows 32 events

  Scenario: AC7 Case outside the scope
    Given case RW-2026-000804 belongs to team "LIT-BKK" and U-81 has scope Own
    When U-81 calls the timeline for RW-2026-000804
    Then the response is 404 with MSG-P4-003
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | Events show in time order; equal times follow the type order decision, status change, assignment, transfer, contact, document, then record ID | FSD A2.45; FEAT-ACA-12 |
| BR2 | An event caused by a rule shows the rule ID and version; an event by a person shows the person | REQ-CWC-016 |
| BR3 | A manual transfer shows its transfer reason | REQ-WKM-003; RWB-E1-021 |
| BR4 | Only cases in the caller's scope open | CTL-09 |
| BR5 | Personal fields in a contact summary follow the masking rules | REQ-ACA-005; DL26 |
| BR6 | The timeline reads in under 2 seconds at the ledger's 2031 size | NFR-070 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It reads the records of past changes.

| RW-REFADM | No Case record right; refused |

### 12. Contract

**GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/timeline**

| Item | Value |

| Request | Path caseId (uuid); query type, from, to; page and size (new query parameters, see additions) |
| Response | TimelinePage of TimelineItem: at, type, summary, by, reference, and the new fields reasonCode, fromQueueCode, toQueueCode and ruleId (recorded with RWB-E2-016) |
| Errors | 401 (MSG-P4-001); 403 no Case record R (MSG-P4-002); 404 not found or out of scope (MSG-P4-003); 503 P3 store unavailable |
| Authorization | Case record, right R, scope applied |
| Idempotency | Not applicable |

The endpoint is first listed for E2 in api.yaml; this story delivers it in E1 behind the flag.

**Published interfaces used**

```java

}
// P5 (RWB-E1-024)

```

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** Back end `recovery/casewf/timeline` (Java package `recovery.casewf.timeline`); front end `src/modules/recovery/casewf/caserecord/timeline`.

**Components**

| TimelinePanel | React component | Panel on SCR-03 with paging, item detail and section messages |

**Database**

- Reads interaction and assignment only; no migration.

**Configuration and reference data**

- Type order list held as parameter `timeline.type.order` (RWB-E1-042).
- LOV-TRANSFER-REASON labels (RWB-E1-021), LOV-DOC-TYPE, LOV-CHANNEL.
- Parameter `caserecord.section.timeout.ms` = 3000 (assumed; DL11).

**Build steps**

1. Mappers for interaction, assignment, document and decision log entry; unit tests.
2. Merge and sort with the type order and record ID tie break; tests AC1, AC5.
3. Paging with total; test AC6.
4. Source timeout and partial result with the section message; test AC3.
5. Scope check; test AC7; a case with only its creation entry; test AC4.
6. TimelinePanel with item detail for transfers; test AC2.
7. Access test.

**Feature flag.** `rwb.p3.timeline`. Off: SCR-03 hides the Timeline panel and the endpoint returns 404.

**Done when.** The tests in section 16 pass and the timeline of a case with 500 events reads in under 2 seconds in SIT (NFR-070).

## RWB-E1-037 Role to permission matrix as data and PDPA field masking by role

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-037 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P4 Access and administration |
| Feature | FEAT-ACA-04 Hold the role to permission matrix as data; FEAT-ACA-05 Mask PDPA fields by role; FEAT-ACA-13 Apply joiner, mover and leaver changes to access; FEAT-ACA-14 Scope a user's cases by team and region |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-ACA-003, REQ-ACA-005, REQ-ACA-007, REQ-ACA-009, REQ-ACA-011 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.4; Business Requirements Epic 2, section 3.4 (REQ-ACA-011); Business Requirements Program, section 5.4 |
| L3 process | All recovery processes |
| Decision | D-RCV-35 (U1, U4); ADR-010 |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-022, RWB-E1-043, RWB-E1-027, RWB-E1-069 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **product owner**, I want **the mapping of roles to capability areas, the scope of each role and the masking of each personal data field held as versioned tables that every screen and API applies, with the identity number masked inside the ACE view and contact values masked at the API**, so that **a change of rights is a data load with an approver, a person sees only the cases in their scope, and personal data shows unmasked only to roles that need it**.

### 2. Business rationale

Audit findings record unsuitable user access to EFS and staff sending debtor data outside the bank. Today rights are set inside each system and cannot be shown for a past date. This story holds the permission matrix (54 roles against 14 capability areas), the masking rules and the scope rule as versioned data, applies scope before permission on every request, and ends access at the next request when a person leaves. Under D-RCV-35 there is no load and no tokenization: ACE ingests the source row once, `v_ace_customer` exposes the identity number as `id_no_masked` and `id_no_last4` only, and `v_ace_contact` exposes the full phone, email and address because notices and calls need them. Masking is therefore applied to view columns, not to a token stored at load. It meets REQ-ACA-003, REQ-ACA-005, REQ-ACA-007, REQ-ACA-009 and REQ-ACA-011 and puts controls CTL-09, CTL-10 and CTL-11 in place. The measure is rule and limit changes made without a code release: target 100 percent (FSD P4 A2.4).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-022 is done: sessions resolve roles from Entra ID groups, and AccessCheck runs on every endpoint.
- RWB-E1-043 is done: POST /admin/reference-loads validates and versions a load file.
- RWB-E1-027 is done: the decision log writer is available through its published interface.
- RWB-E1-069 is done: `v_ace_customer` and `v_ace_contact` exist, and `recovery_svc` holds SELECT on them and no privilege on `public`.
- Permission matrix version PM-2026.11 (from the Users, roles and permissions workbook) is the version in force.
- Masking version MASK-2026.11 is loaded with no unmasked rows in PROD until Compliance supplies the rules (DL26), so every personal field is masked for every role. SIT carries a test version MASK-SIT-01.
- The masking rules name the view field IDs of Physical Schema v6: DF-ACE-073 `id_no_masked`, DF-ACE-074 `id_no_last4`, DF-ACE-078 `contact_value` and DF-ACE-079 `contact_value_masked`, plus the name, date of birth and customer number fields.
- The P3 queue membership interface from RWB-E1-019 returns the teams and regions of a user.
- Parameters `rwb.refload.approver.permission=RW-SECADM` and `rwb.refload.approver.masking_rule=RW-COMPLY` are in the parameter catalog (RWB-E1-042).

### 4. Flow

1. Reference data administrator (RW-REFADM): prepares the matrix file from the approved workbook, with the application owner's approval reference in the file header, and calls POST /admin/reference-loads with table "permission" and validFrom.
2. Workbench (PermissionMatrixLoader): validates the file whole: every active role once against all 14 capability areas, letters only from C, R, U, D, A in that order or "-", known role codes; stores the rows with status Loaded and the new matrix_version.
3. Security administrator (RW-SECADM): reviews the difference report against the version in force and calls POST /admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/approve.
4. Workbench: checks that the approver holds the role the parameter names for the table and is not the person who loaded it; writes one decision log entry for the approval with decision code AC-VERS and no case; marks the version Approved with its valid from date.
5. Workbench: from the valid from date, every new session resolves the new version (RWB-E1-022 keeps open sessions on their version), and the screens and endpoints of the new letters open with no deployment.
6. Person: requests a list or a record; ScopeService builds the filter from the role's default scope (own, team, region, all) and the person's teams and regions; the owning module applies it in its query.
7. Workbench: AccessCheck tests the right in the capability area on the records inside the scope.
8. Workbench (FieldMasker): for each field tagged as personal data, reads the masking rule in force for the session's roles. When no rule lets a role see the field in clear, the response is filled from the masked view column (`v_ace_customer.id_no_masked`, `v_ace_contact.contact_value_masked`) or the value is masked by the masker where the view holds no masked column. When a rule allows it, the response is filled from the clear view column where ACE exposes one (`v_ace_contact.contact_value`) or from `id_no_last4` for the identity number. There is no token and no detokenization call.
9. Workbench: the clear `customer.identification_number` never leaves ACE. No Workbench column, token store or service returns it, and `id_no_last4` is the clearest identity value any role can receive.
10. Workbench: writes one access event with the field IDs and their masked flags, never a value, through the access log (RWB-E1-039).
11. Workbench: on each request, compares the session's groups with the groups the ACE common module holds for the person (refreshed at most every 5 minutes, assumed; DL38); if a group has been removed the session ends and the request is refused.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | A role without the right calls an action, for example a transfer | Refused with 403 before the handler runs; nothing changes; refusal logged | MSG-P4-002 | AC3 |
| X2 | A record outside the person's scope is requested | Refused with 404; the record is not returned and the count of excluded records is never shown | MSG-P4-003 | AC4 |
| X3 | A matrix file misses a role, repeats a role and area, or holds a letter outside C, R, U, D, A and "-" | The load is refused in full; the version in force stays | MSG-P1-002 | AC5 |
| X4 | The person who loaded a version tries to approve it | Refused; the version stays Loaded | MSG-P7-002 | AC6 |
| X5 | A role other than the table's approver role calls approve | Refused with 403 | MSG-P4-002 | AC6, AC13 |
| X6 | The decision log write for an approval fails | The version is not approved and stays Loaded | MSG-P7-003 | AC7 |
| X7 | A leaver's group is removed while a session is open | The next request after the membership refresh ends the session | MSG-P4-001 | AC8 |
| X8 | No masking rule exists for a personal field and role | The field shows from the masked view column, or is masked by the masker where the view holds no masked column | None | AC9 |
| X9 | Two approve calls for the same load arrive at once | One approves; the second returns 409 and writes nothing | MSG-GEN-004 | AC10 |
| X10 | A rule asks for the clear identity number | The rule is refused at load; the clearest value a rule can name is `id_no_last4` | MSG-P1-002 | TC-E1-037-13 |

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Builds on the session (RWB-E1-022), the load service (RWB-E1-043), the writer (RWB-E1-027) and the ACE views (RWB-E1-069), all earlier in Epic 1 |
| Negotiable | Letters, scopes and masking positions are data; Compliance sets the masking values under DL26 |
| Valuable | A change of rights takes effect by an approved load, and personal data is masked by default from the view and the API |
| Estimable | One loader, one scope service, one masker, one approval check |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion below is one test in section 16 |

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | The permission matrix version in force is the only source of what a role may do; a capability area with "-" refuses every action in it | permission.letters (DF-REF-043), matrix_version (DF-REF-044); REQ-ACA-003; CTL-09 |
| BR2 | A matrix file holds every active role once for each of the 14 capability areas, with letters from C, R, U, D, A in that order or "-"; a file with any error is refused in full | LOV-CAPABILITY; reference data change process, step 3 |
| BR3 | A version is approved by the role the parameter names for the table, and never by the person who loaded it | Parameters rwb.refload.approver.*; Admin and access model, section 3.3; CTL-05 |
| BR4 | Scope filters records first and the permission is checked second; an out-of-scope record is never returned and the excluded count is never shown | role.default_scope (DF-REF-038); LOV-SCOPE; REQ-ACA-009 |
| BR5 | OWN means cases the person owns or has a task on; TEAM means cases in the person's team queues; REGION means cases in the regions of the person's teams; ALL means every case | Key sheet, roles.txt |
| BR6 | A personal data field is masked unless the masking rule in force lets one of the session's roles see it. A masked field is filled from the masked view column (`id_no_masked`, `contact_value_masked`), or masked by the masker where the view holds no masked column; with no rule it is masked | Masking rules reference table; DL26; CTL-11; REQ-ACA-005; DF-ACE-073, DF-ACE-079 |
| BR7 | Masking is applied before data reaches a screen or an agent | NFR-039; NFR-040 |
| BR8 | A leaver's removal from a group ends the open session at the next request after the membership refresh; leaver removal is within the same working day | DL38; CTL-10; REQ-ACA-011 |
| BR9 | A version approval that cannot be written to the decision log does not take effect | Principle 5; R-UNI-39; CTL-06 |
| BR10 | There is no tokenization and no token store. The clear `customer.identification_number` never leaves ACE; `v_ace_customer` exposes `id_no_masked` and `id_no_last4` only, and `id_no_last4` is the clearest identity value any role can receive | ADR-010; Data Tier Map section 7; D-RCV-35 U1 |
| BR11 | Every read of a personal data field is written to the access log with the field ID and its masked flag, never the value | REQ-ACA-006; RWB-E1-039 BR3; NFR-040 |
| BR12 | A masking rule names a field ID that exists in `sys_fields` with `is_personal` true and belongs to a `recovery.v_ace_*` view or a Workbench table; a rule that names the clear identity number is refused | RWB-E1-069; Data Tier Map section 7 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It moves a reference load from Loaded to Approved (or Refused at validation), and a session from Resolved to Ended when a group is removed.

### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| Application owner (level 1, assumed DL02) | Approves each permission matrix version outside the Workbench; the approval reference is carried in the load file |
| Role owners (level 2) | Request matrix changes for the roles they own |
| RW-REFADM Reference data administrator | Loads a matrix or masking version (Reference data C). Approves none |
| RW-COE Center of excellence analyst | Holds Reference data C and may load; may not approve |
| RW-SECADM Security administrator | Approves a permission or role conflict version (approver role for the table, parameter) |
| RW-COMPLY Compliance and PDPA officer | Sets the masking rules and approves each masking version (approver role for the table, parameter) |
| RW-AUDIT Internal audit | Reads every version and the approval entries; changes nothing |
| Access administrator (level 3, bank IAM) | Removes leavers and movers from Entra ID groups |
| Line manager (level 4, bank IAM) | Starts mover and leaver changes |
| Every bank role | Sees cases inside the default scope of its roles, with fields masked per the masking rules |
| ACE team lead | Owns the ACE tables and columns behind `v_ace_customer` and `v_ace_contact` |

### 12. Contract

**POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/reference-loads** (API-P4-005)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | Multipart: file (xlsx or csv), table ("permission" or "masking_rule"), validFrom (date) |
| Response | 201 ReferenceLoad: id, table, validFrom, status "Loaded", rows |
| Errors | 401 no session; 403 no Reference data C (MSG-P4-002); 409 a version with the same name exists (MSG-GEN-004); 422 validation failed (MSG-P1-002, with the failed check in detail); 503 store unavailable (MSG-GEN-006) |
| Authorization | Reference data, right C |
| Idempotency | Idempotency-Key header; the same key returns the first response |

**POST /admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/approve** (API-P4-006)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | None |
| Response | 200 ReferenceLoad with status "Approved" |
| Errors | 401; 403 caller does not hold the approver role for the table (MSG-P4-002); 404 no such load (MSG-P4-003); 409 caller loaded it (MSG-P7-002), or the load is not "Loaded" (MSG-GEN-004); 503 decision log write failed (MSG-P7-003) |
| Authorization | api.yaml declares Reference data, right A, which no role holds in PM-2026.11. This story checks the approver role named for the table in the parameter catalog instead; the change is recorded in the additions file |
| Idempotency | Idempotency-Key header; a repeat approve of an Approved load returns 409 and writes nothing |

**POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/transfer** (owned by P3; used in AC3 only to show the refusal): Queue and allocation, right U.

**Published interfaces** (package recovery.access.matrix):

```java
ScopeFilter scopeFor(SessionContext session);            // type OWN|TEAM|REGION|ALL, userRef, teamCodes, regionCodes
<T> T mask(T dto, SessionContext session);               // fills each field annotated @PersonalData("DF-...") from the masked or clear view column
boolean isUnmasked(String fieldId, SessionContext session);
```

`mask` reads `v_ace_customer.id_no_masked`, `v_ace_customer.id_no_last4`, `v_ace_contact.contact_value` and `v_ace_contact.contact_value_masked` as the masking rule directs. It makes no detokenization call and holds no token.

### 13. Solution plan

- Package: folder `recovery/access/matrix` in the recovery module; Java package `recovery.access.matrix`.
- Components:

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| AccessAndAdministrationController | Controller | Reference load and approve endpoints for the permission and masking_rule tables |
| PermissionMatrixLoader | Service | Validates a matrix file whole and stores rows with status Loaded |
| MaskingRuleLoader | Service | Validates a masking file: known role codes, field IDs that exist in sys_fields with is_personal true, and no rule naming the clear identity number |
| ReferenceLoadApprovalService | Service | Approver role check, maker and checker check, decision log write, status change in one transaction |
| ScopeService | Published interface | Builds ScopeFilter from the default scope and the P3 queue membership interface |
| FieldMasker | Published interface | Fills annotated DTO fields from the masked or clear view column named by the masking rule; masks the value where the view holds no masked column |
| SessionRevalidationFilter | Service | Compares session groups with the ACE common module's current groups on each request |
| AccessAndAdministrationRepository | Repository | Reads and writes permission and masking_rule rows |
| MaskingRule | Entity | Maps the masking_rule table |

- Database: writes permission (role_id, capability_area, letters, matrix_version, state, is_active) and adds unique index uk_permission_version on permission (matrix_version, role_id, capability_area). masking_rule comes from V0001 (RWB-E1-001) with uk_masking_rule on (role_code, field_id, masking_version). Flyway migration `V_E1_037__permission_version_index.sql` adds the index. Writes decision_log_entry through the P7 writer only.
- Configuration and reference data: PM-2026.11 (RW-REFADM loads, RW-SECADM approves); MASK-2026.11 (RW-REFADM loads, RW-COMPLY approves; values DL26); parameters rwb.refload.approver.permission, rwb.refload.approver.masking_rule, rwb.access.membership-refresh-minutes=5 (assumed, DL38); LOV-CAPABILITY, LOV-SCOPE. The masking shape (the last four characters, or the first character and the domain of an email address) is the view function `recovery.ace_mask_value`, so no Workbench parameter sets it.
- Build steps:
  1. Create the permission unique index.
  2. Build PermissionMatrixLoader and MaskingRuleLoader with whole-file validation, the personal-field check that refuses the clear identity number and a difference report against the version in force; tests for AC5.
  3. Build ReferenceLoadApprovalService with the approver role check, maker and checker check, optimistic lock on the load and the decision log write in one transaction; tests for AC1, AC6, AC7, AC10, AC13.
  4. Build ScopeService and the ScopeFilter contract; give P3 a repository test that applies it to GET /cases and GET /cases/{caseId}; tests for AC4.
  5. Build FieldMasker over the view columns and the @PersonalData annotation; tests for AC2, AC9, AC12.
  6. Build the identity boundary test (grants, view columns, no token store); test for AC11.
  7. Build SessionRevalidationFilter; test for AC8 with a group removed in the ACE test double.
  8. Confirm AC3 through the AccessCheckInterceptor from RWB-E1-022 on the transfer endpoint.
- Feature flag: `rwb.access.permission-matrix`.
- Done when: the tests in section 16 pass, and the masking test in the access test set (three roles open the same case) passes in SIT and is signed by Compliance.

### 14. Validation and messages

| ID | When | Message |
|---|---|---|
| MSG-P4-001 | Session ended after a leaver's group was removed | You have no Recovery Workbench role. Ask your team manager to request one. |
| MSG-P4-002 | An action outside the role's permission, or approve by a role that is not the table's approver | You cannot {action} here. Your role does not include it. |
| MSG-P4-003 | A record outside the role's scope | This case is not in your scope. |
| MSG-P1-002 | A matrix or masking file fails validation | The {source} load for {date} was refused: {check}. The previous load is still in use. |
| MSG-P7-002 | The loader tries to approve their own load | You prepared this decision, so you cannot approve it. |
| MSG-P7-003 | The approval cannot be written to the decision log | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |
| MSG-GEN-004 | A second approve of a load already approved | Someone else changed this record. Reload it to see their change. |
| MSG-GEN-006 | The reference data store is unavailable | {system} is not available. Your request is queued and will be retried. |

Thai text for each message follows DL10.

### 15. Screens and states

No screen in this story. Matrix and masking versions arrive by file load until SCR-43 Roles and access and SCR-47 Personal data come in Epic 8. A person sees the effect in the menu (RWB-E1-022), in masked fields on the case record view (RWB-E1-023) and in 404 responses for out-of-scope cases.

| TC-E1-037-12 | Principle 5 | Resilience | The decision log write forced to fail during an approval |
| TC-E1-037-13 | AC11, BR10, BR12 | System | A rule naming the clear identity number is refused; `public.customer` grant refused; `v_ace_customer` id_no_masked and id_no_last4 |
| TC-E1-037-14 | AC12, BR11 | System | RW-CASEOWN test user reading DF-ACE-078 in clear |
| TC-E1-037-15 | AC13, BR3 | System | RW-COE test user calling approve on a Loaded version |

The full test, with its Given, When and Then, is in Recovery Workbench Test Cases v7.xlsx, tab Story test cases, under the same test case ID.

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: letters, scopes, masking positions, approver roles and the refresh interval are data or parameters.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts. Tests use synthetic values; the access event lists field IDs and their masked flag, never values.
- ACE data only through the `recovery.v_ace_*` views: identity, name, date of birth and contact values come from `v_ace_customer` and `v_ace_contact`. The recovery schema holds no foreign key into a `public` table.
- No tokenization and no token store. The clear identity number never leaves ACE, and no Workbench column, service or rule returns it.
- An unmasked contact value is read from `v_ace_contact.contact_value` only where the masking rule allows it, and every such read is audited.
- A field with no masking rule is masked.
