## RWB-E1-049 OCR pipeline on the Workbench document hub

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-049 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-07 Run the OCR pipeline on inbound documents |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-006, REQ-DCM-009 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.5; Business Requirements Program, section 5.5 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-TE-012, RWB-E1-024, RWB-E1-045 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **case owner (RW-CASEOWN)**, I want **every inbound scan and upload read by the OCR service into text and layout in Thai and English, stored against the intake item and the document**, so that **classification and extraction can start and an unreadable page is sent back for rescan the same day**.

### 2. Business rationale

Scanned documents arrive as images; nothing in them can be classified, extracted or searched until the text is read (FSD P5 A2.7). This story builds the OCR step of the document intake: one intake record per file, the text and layout of every page, a quality check per page and a rescan request when a page cannot be read. It meets REQ-DCM-006 (fields extracted in Thai and English, which needs Thai and English text first) and REQ-DCM-009 (every path ends in the same intake). The measure is fields extracted without review (FSD P5 A2.7.1).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-024 is done: documents are stored and DocumentStored (EV-16) is published.
- RWB-TE-012 is done: the intake and standard containers exist.
- RWB-E1-045 is done: product parameters are held as data.
- Document hub parameters loaded: OCR_MIN_QUALITY = 0.70, OCR_WORKERS = 4, OCR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120, OCR_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3 (all assumed, DL11).
- The OCR service run by Autonomous Ops is reachable from SIT through the OcrClient adapter under the service identity SY-OCR.
- An intake item has scan_result CLEAN. The malware scan step is added in RWB-E1-041; until then test data is seeded CLEAN.
- Feature flag rwb.dochub.ocr is on.

### 4. Flow

1. JOB-12 Document intake: starts every 15 minutes in business hours and runs the OCR step after the intake and scan steps.
2. DocumentStoredListener: for each DocumentStored event with source UPLOAD, creates an intake item with the case ID, the document ID and scan_result CLEAN (the upload was scanned before storage).
3. OcrStep: selects intake items with scan_result CLEAN and ocr_status PENDING, oldest first, locking each row so that no two workers take the same item; runs up to OCR_WORKERS items in parallel.
4. OcrClient: sends the file to the OCR service with the languages Thai and English and receives, per page, the lines, words, positions, language and word confidence.
5. OcrStep: computes the page quality as the mean word confidence of the page; stores the full output as JSON at ocr/{intakeId}.json in the standard container and sets ocr_ref.
6. OcrStep: writes one document_text row per page with the page text and quality, with the document ID where the item is already attached.
7. OcrStep: if every page has quality at or above OCR_MIN_QUALITY, sets ocr_status DONE; otherwise sets ocr_status RESCAN and rescan_pages to the page numbers below the threshold.
8. OcrStep: for an item in RESCAN with a known case, sends MSG-P5-018 to the case owner through the ACE notification path; for an item with no case, sets review_reason RESCAN so the item shows in the document review queue (SCR-31, RWB-E1-054).
9. OcrStep: records the run counts (read, done, rescan, failed) on the job record shown in the job monitor.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | A page has quality below OCR_MIN_QUALITY | Item set RESCAN with the page numbers; case owner told, or the item goes to the review queue | MSG-P5-018 | AC3, AC4 |
| X2 | Page quality exactly at OCR_MIN_QUALITY | The page is accepted | None | AC5 |
| X3 | The OCR service does not answer within OCR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS or returns an error | ocr_attempts increases; the item stays PENDING for the next run; after two failed runs the job raises an alert to the platform administrator (JOB-12) | None | AC6 |
| X4 | The item fails OCR_MAX_ATTEMPTS times or the file cannot be opened | ocr_status FAILED; review_reason UNREADABLE_FILE; item in the review queue | None | AC7 |
| X5 | The job runs again over items already DONE | Items are not read again; no second set of text rows | None | AC8 |
| X6 | Two workers start on the same item | The row lock lets one worker take it; the other skips it | None | AC9 |
| X7 | A user without the Documents right reads a document holding OCR text | Refused with 403; no text returned | MSG-P4-002 | TC-E1-049-10 (Access) |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs the store (RWB-E1-024) and the containers (RWB-TE-012); classification (RWB-E1-050) and extraction (RWB-E1-053) build on its output |
| Negotiable | Quality threshold, workers, timeout and attempts are parameters; the OCR service can change behind OcrClient |
| Valuable | Every scan becomes text that the later steps and the search read |
| Estimable | One table pair, one job step, one adapter, one listener |
| Small | Fits within two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion below is one test case in section 16 |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: OCR pipeline on the Workbench document hub

  Background:
    Given OCR_MIN_QUALITY is 0.70, OCR_WORKERS is 4 and OCR_MAX_ATTEMPTS is 3
    Given the OCR service stub in SIT is replaced by the OCR service for AC1 and AC2

  Scenario: AC1 Sample processed
    Given the 180 synthetic sample documents, 30 of each of the six agreed types, in Thai and English, each as a CLEAN intake item
    When JOB-12 Document intake runs
    Then each of the 180 items has ocr_status "DONE" or "RESCAN" and an ocr_ref to its JSON output
    Then each page has a document_text row with the page text and its quality
    Then the text of the sample pages holds Thai and English words, and the languages recorded per item are "th" and "en" where both appear

  Scenario: AC2 Throughput
    Given 500 pages in 125 CLEAN intake items in SIT
    When they are processed by JOB-12 with 4 workers
    Then all 125 items reach "DONE" or "RESCAN" within 60 minutes of the first item starting

  Scenario: AC3 Unreadable page on a known case
    Given an uploaded court notice of 4 pages on case "RW-2026-000123" owned by user "TEST-CO-01"
    Given page 3 has quality 0.41 and the other pages are above 0.70
    When the OCR step runs
    Then the intake item has ocr_status "RESCAN" and rescan_pages "3"
    Then "TEST-CO-01" receives MSG-P5-018 naming page 3, the document and case "RW-2026-000123"

  Scenario: AC4 Unreadable page with no case yet
    Given a mailroom scan of 2 pages with no case and page 1 at quality 0.30
    When the OCR step runs
    Then the intake item has ocr_status "RESCAN", rescan_pages "1" and review_reason "RESCAN"
    Then the system sends no notification

  Scenario: AC5 Quality at the threshold
    Given a scan of 1 page with quality 0.70
    When the OCR step runs
    Then the item has ocr_status "DONE" and no rescan pages

  Scenario: AC6 OCR service unavailable
    Given the OCR service stub returns HTTP 503 for every call
    When JOB-12 runs twice
    Then each pending item has ocr_status "PENDING" and ocr_attempts 2
    Then the job monitor shows the OCR step failed in both runs and an alert is raised to the platform administrator
    Then when the service answers again the next run sets the items "DONE"

  Scenario: AC7 File that cannot be read
    Given a password-protected PDF as a CLEAN intake item
    When the OCR step runs
    Then the item has ocr_status "FAILED" and review_reason "UNREADABLE_FILE"
    Then no document_text row exists for it

  Scenario: AC8 Repeat run
    Given 10 intake items already "DONE" with 25 document_text rows
    When JOB-12 runs again
    Then the OCR service receives no call for those items
    Then they still have 25 document_text rows

  Scenario: AC9 Two workers on one item
    Given one CLEAN pending item and 4 workers starting at the same time
    When the OCR step runs
    Then the OCR service receives exactly one call for the item
    Then the item has one set of document_text rows
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | Every inbound file is read in Thai and English | REQ-DCM-006; FEAT-DCM-07 |
| BR2 | Scans, partner files, emails and uploads go through the same intake item and OCR step | REQ-DCM-009 |
| BR3 | A file is read only after its malware scan is CLEAN | REQ-DCM-010; FEAT-DCM-18 |
| BR4 | A page below OCR_MIN_QUALITY is sent for rescan; the threshold is inclusive | Document hub parameter OCR_MIN_QUALITY (New); DL11 |
| BR5 | A system that does not answer is retried on the next run and alerted after two failed runs | R-UNI-33; JOB-12 |
| BR6 | An item read once is not read again | R-UNI-40 |
| BR7 | Worker count, timeout and attempts are parameters | Principle 1; DT02 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It changes the intake item OCR status: PENDING to DONE when every page passes; PENDING to RESCAN when a page is below the threshold; PENDING stays PENDING after a failed call below the attempt limit; PENDING to FAILED at the attempt limit or for a file that cannot be opened.

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** Folder `recovery/dochub/ocr`, Java package `recovery.dochub.ocr`.

**Components.**

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| DocumentIntakeJob | Job | Spring Batch job behind JOB-12 with ordered steps; this story builds the job and ocrStep |
| OcrStep | Job | Selects, locks and reads items; applies the quality rule; writes output |
| OcrClient, OcrServiceAdapter | Service | Calls the OCR service; maps errors to OcrUnavailableException and UnreadableFileException |
| DocumentStoredListener | Listener | Creates an intake item for each uploaded document |
| RescanNotifier | Service | Sends MSG-P5-018 to the case owner through the ACE notification path |
| DocumentIntakeRepository | Repository | Reads and writes document_intake only |
| DocumentTextRepository | Repository | Writes document_text |
| OcrOutputReader | Published interface | Section 12 |

**Database.**
- Flyway migration `V1_5_049__document_intake.sql` creates document_intake (id, source varchar(12), source_ref varchar(120), received_at timestamptz, file_sha256 char(64), intake_ref varchar(400), scan_result varchar(10), case_id uuid, document_id uuid, ocr_ref varchar(400), ocr_status varchar(12) default 'PENDING', ocr_attempts integer default 0, page_count integer, rescan_pages varchar(200), ocr_quality numeric(5,4), languages varchar(20), ocr_engine_version varchar(40), review_reason varchar(20), plus the standard columns) and document_text (id, intake_id uuid not null, document_id uuid, page_no integer, text_content text, quality numeric(5,4), plus the standard columns).
- Foreign keys document_intake.document_id and document_text.document_id to document(id); document_text.intake_id to document_intake(id).
- Indexes: ix_intake_ocr_pending on document_intake (ocr_status, received_at) where scan_result = 'CLEAN'; unique uk_document_text_page on document_text (intake_id, page_no); ix_document_text_document on document_text (document_id).
- Row selection uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

**Configuration and reference data.**
- Parameters OCR_MIN_QUALITY, OCR_WORKERS, OCR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, OCR_MAX_ATTEMPTS in document_hub_parameter, loaded by the reference data administrator.
- Property rwb.dochub.ocr.endpoint, set per environment by the platform administrator.
- Notification template for MSG-P5-018 in the ACE notification path, recovery templates.

**Build steps.**
1. Write the migration and the entities; test the unique page index.
2. Build OcrClient against a stub that returns fixed pages; contract test of the response mapping.
3. Build OcrStep selection with SKIP LOCKED and the worker pool; test AC8 and AC9.
4. Add the quality rule and the status setting; test AC3, AC4 and AC5 on synthetic pages.
5. Add retry, attempts and the FAILED rule; test AC6 and AC7.
6. Build DocumentStoredListener and RescanNotifier; test AC3 end to end.
7. Run the 180 sample documents and the 500-page set in SIT against the OCR service; record the results for AC1 and AC2.

**Feature flag.** `rwb.dochub.ocr`. Off: ocrStep is skipped and items stay PENDING.

**Done when.** The tests in section 16 pass and the 500-page run in SIT finishes within 60 minutes.

## RWB-E1-050 Document classification

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-050 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-08 Classify a document into one of the six types |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-005 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.5; Business Requirements Program, section 5.5 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-049, RWB-E1-025 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **case owner (RW-CASEOWN)**, I want **each scanned document classified into one of the six agreed types with a confidence score, and any document below the threshold sent to the review queue with its top two candidate types**, so that **each document is filed under the right type and checklist item without a person typing it**.

### 2. Business rationale

A scan arrives with no type; today a person reads it and files it by hand. Classification reads the OCR text and names the type with a confidence, so the document can be attached, extracted and counted against the case checklist (FSD P5 A2.8). A document the model is unsure of goes to a person, so no document is filed under the wrong type. It meets REQ-DCM-005 and serves the measure fields extracted without review (FSD P5 A2.8.1).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-049 is done: intake items carry OCR text and ocr_status.
- RWB-E1-025 is done: document type table DOCTYPE-2026.11 is in force.
- Parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD = 0.80 loaded in document_hub_parameter (assumed until the RWB-E1-060 report; DL11). RWB-E1-054 routes to review on the same value.
- Parameters loaded: CLASSIFY_MAX_PAGES = 3, CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60 (R-UNI-32), assumed.
- The classifier model endpoint is set under DL33 and reachable through the P10 model gateway in SIT; its model version is known.
- The labeled sample of 180 synthetic documents, 30 per type, holds the true type of each document.
- Feature flag rwb.dochub.classify is on.

### 4. Flow

1. JOB-12 Document intake: runs classifyStep after ocrStep.
2. ClassifyStep: selects intake items with ocr_status DONE, no predicted_type and no document type given (uploads carry their type and are skipped), locking each row.
3. ClassifyStep: takes the text of the first CLASSIFY_MAX_PAGES pages and replaces national ID numbers, account numbers and phone numbers with tokens through the ACE PII masking service.
4. ClassifierClient: sends the masked text and the six type codes with their labels from the type table in force; receives a score per type and the model version.
5. ClassifyStep: ranks the scores; writes predicted_type, classification_confidence, the top two candidates in type_candidates and classifier_version.
6. ClassifyStep: if the top score is at or above CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD and the type is in the table in force, marks the item classified with no review_reason; attach (RWB-E1-032) stores it with review_status NOT_NEEDED.
7. ClassifyStep: below the threshold, sets review_reason LOW_CONFIDENCE; attach (RWB-E1-032) stores the document with review_status PENDING and write_once false, so it shows on SCR-31 with MSG-P5-003 and its two candidates (RWB-E1-054). A type outside the table sets review_reason UNKNOWN_TYPE with no predicted type, and attach holds the item for a person.
8. ClassificationEvaluationRunner: on demand, runs the labeled sample, writes the accuracy and the 6 by 6 confusion matrix to evaluation/classification/{runDate}.json in the standard container and to the job record.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | Top score below the threshold | Item marked LOW_CONFIDENCE with the two candidates; stored for review at attach | MSG-P5-003 | AC2 |
| X2 | Top score exactly at the threshold | Item classified | None | AC3 |
| X3 | Classifier does not answer within CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS | Fallback: item to review with reason MODEL_UNAVAILABLE; the fallback is recorded on the item | MSG-P5-003 | AC4 |
| X4 | The model returns a type code not in the table in force | Item to review with reason UNKNOWN_TYPE | MSG-P5-003 | AC5 |
| X5 | The item already carries a type (upload) | Not classified | None | AC6 |
| X6 | The item is in RESCAN or FAILED | Not classified | None | AC7 |
| X7 | The job runs again over classified items | Not classified again; no second model call | None | AC8 |
| X8 | A user without Documents R reads the classification of a document | Refused with 403 | MSG-P4-002 | TC-E1-050-11 (Access) |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs OCR output (RWB-E1-049) and the type table (RWB-E1-025); attach (RWB-E1-032) reads its result |
| Negotiable | Thresholds and pages read are data; the model behind ClassifierClient can change under DL33 |
| Valuable | Removes hand filing for every document the model is sure of |
| Estimable | One job step, one adapter, one evaluation runner |
| Small | Fits within two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion below is one test case in section 16 |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin
Feature: Document classification

  Background:
    Given document type table version "DOCTYPE-2026.11" is in force
    Given parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD is 0.80
    Given CLASSIFY_MAX_PAGES is 3 and CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 60

  Scenario: AC1 Accuracy
    Given the labeled sample of 180 synthetic documents, 30 of each type, with ocr_status "DONE"
    When ClassificationEvaluationRunner runs on the sample
    Then at least 162 of the 180 documents get the labeled type as predicted_type
    Then the report "evaluation/classification/2026-11-20.json" holds the accuracy, the 6 by 6 confusion matrix and the model version

  Scenario: AC2 Low confidence routed
    Given a scanned intake item whose scores are COURT_NOTICE 0.62, DEMAND_LETTER 0.21 and the rest below 0.10
    When classification runs
    Then the item has predicted_type "COURT_NOTICE", classification_confidence 0.6200 and review_reason "LOW_CONFIDENCE"
    Then type_candidates holds COURT_NOTICE 0.62 and DEMAND_LETTER 0.21
    Then the system passes the item to attach marked for type review, with write_once to be set false on the stored document

  Scenario: AC3 Score at the threshold
    Given a scanned intake item whose top score is APPRAISAL_REPORT 0.80
    When classification runs
    Then the system classifies the item as "APPRAISAL_REPORT" with no review_reason

  Scenario: AC4 Classifier does not answer
    Given the classifier stub does not answer within 60 seconds
    When classification runs for one item
    Then the item has review_reason "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE" and no predicted_type
    Then the item records that the fallback was used

  Scenario: AC5 Type not in the table
    Given the classifier returns "LOAN_CONTRACT" 0.91 for an item
    When classification runs
    Then the item has review_reason "UNKNOWN_TYPE"
    Then type_candidates holds the two highest agreed types

  Scenario: AC6 Upload with a type given
    Given an intake item created from an upload of type "TITLE_DEED"
    When classification runs
    Then the classifier receives no call for it and its type stays "TITLE_DEED"

  Scenario: AC7 Item waiting for rescan
    Given an intake item with ocr_status "RESCAN"
    When classification runs
    Then the classifier receives no call for it

  Scenario: AC8 Repeat run
    Given 20 items already classified
    When JOB-12 runs again
    Then the classifier receives no call for those 20 items and their results are unchanged

  Scenario: AC9 Threshold changed as data
    Given parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD is changed to 0.90 in document_hub_parameter
    Given a scanned item whose top score is COURT_NOTICE 0.85
    When classification runs
    Then the item has review_reason "LOW_CONFIDENCE"
    Then no code or deployment changed between the two values

  Scenario: AC10 Personal identifiers masked before the model call
    Given a scanned page holding the synthetic national ID number "0000000000000" and account number "TEST-ACC-0001"
    When classification runs
    Then the text received by the classifier stub holds tokens in place of both values
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | A document is classified into one of the agreed types with a confidence score | REQ-DCM-005; FEAT-DCM-08 |
| BR2 | Below the threshold the document goes to the review queue; the threshold is inclusive | REQ-DCM-005; parameter CLASSIFY_THRESHOLD in document_hub_parameter (New); DL11 |
| BR3 | The types come from the type table in force and the threshold from document_hub_parameter | DL19; principle 1 |
| BR4 | A model that does not answer within the timeout falls back to review and the fallback is recorded | R-UNI-32 |
| BR5 | Accuracy on the labeled sample is at least 90 percent before the step runs in production | Story acceptance; FEAT-AGT-04 |
| BR6 | Personal identifiers are masked before text leaves the document hub | CTL-11; DL26; DL33 |
| BR7 | An item classified once is not classified again | R-UNI-40 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It changes the intake item: OCR DONE to CLASSIFIED when the top score meets the threshold; OCR DONE to review with review_reason LOW_CONFIDENCE, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE or UNKNOWN_TYPE otherwise.

**Package.** Folder `recovery/dochub/classify`, Java package `recovery.dochub.classify`.

| Decision | D7.1; D-RCV-35 (U1, U4); ADR-010; DL43 open |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-015, RWB-E1-018, RWB-E1-027, RWB-E1-046, RWB-E1-069 |
| Status | Ready for build, proof of delivery behind a flag until RWB-ACE-001 lands (DL43) |

### 1. Story

As a **litigation officer (RW-LITOFF)**, I want **demand, recall and guarantor notices generated from the Legal-approved template with the case data merged, the party and the notice address read from the ACE views by business key**, so that **letters are produced without re-keying and the address on the notice is the address ACE holds**.

### 2. Business rationale

Notices are typed by hand from the core bank screens, so a wrong amount or address on a notice can void the notice period and delay litigation. Under D-RCV-35 the Workbench holds no party and no contact point: the name comes from `v_ace_customer` by `person_key`, the notice address and phone come from `v_ace_contact` by the composite `contact_key` (`contact_type:key`), and the outstanding comes from `v_ace_account` by `account_key`. The clear identity number never leaves ACE, so it is never merged. This story merges those values into the current approved template, stores the PDF write-once on the case with the template version in the footer and records the decision. It serves REQ-OCC-001 and control CTL-14, and is the input to dispatch and proof of delivery (RWB-E1-055), where the WIN record is read from `v_ace_pod`. The FSD P6 measure "notices with proof of delivery, 100 percent" depends on it.

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-046 is done: TemplateCatalog returns the current Approved version.
- RWB-E1-018 is done: cases exist with `person_key` links on case_party.
- RWB-E1-027 is done: the decision log writer accepts D7.1 entries.
- RWB-E1-015 is done: each data product carries its freshness stamp from the ACE batch.
- RWB-E1-069 is done: `v_ace_customer`, `v_ace_contact` and `v_ace_account` are Section A views. `v_ace_pod` is a Section B view over `public.pod_receipt`, so the delivery facts stay behind their flag until RWB-ACE-001 lands (DL43).
- Templates for DEMAND, RECALL and GUARANTOR_NOTICE are Approved for the product groups in the synthetic set, in language TH.
- The customer, the contact points and the account are in ACE (SCBPDM and ALS ingestion); `recovery_svc` holds SELECT on `recovery.v_ace_*` and no privilege on `public`.
- The caller is `recovery_svc`, or a person through RWB-E2-021 from Epic 2.

### 4. Flow

1. Caller: calls NoticeApi.generate with case ID, notice type, `person_key` and language.
2. System: reads the case summary (case number, product group, status) through the P3 interface and the party role through `case_party` by `person_key`.
3. System: asks TemplateCatalog for the current LETTER template for the notice type, product group and language on the business date.
4. System: resolves each merge code through the interface that owns its source field: `CASE_NO`, `PRODUCT_GROUP` and `ENTRY_DATE` from P3; `CUSTOMER_NAME` from `v_ace_customer.first_name` and `.last_name` by `person_key`; `POSTAL_ADDRESS` and `PHONE` from `v_ace_contact` by `person_key` and `contact_type`; `TOTAL_OUTSTANDING` from `v_ace_account.total_balance` by the case's primary `account_key`. Each value carries the ACE business date of its view or batch.
5. System: if a required merge value is empty, holds the notice, names the field and raises a task to the case owner; stops.
6. System: renders the DOCX template to PDF and adds the footer: case number, template code, template version and generation date.
7. System: writes the D7.1 decision log entry with rule R-LIT-03, the template code and version and the reference to the merge snapshot. The snapshot holds the merge code, the view column, the business key and the field ID of each value used, never the value.
8. System: stores the PDF in the document hub as a generated, write-once document on the case.
9. System: creates the notice row with `person_key`, `template_id`, notice type, sent type and state Generated, and writes NoticeGenerated to the outbox in the same transaction.
10. System: when the notice is read, takes the sent date, barcode, callback date and delivery status from `v_ace_pod` by `notice_ref`. The Workbench writes no WIN delivery fact of its own.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | The template has no Approved version | Refused; no notice and no document created | MSG-P6-005 | AC2 |
| X2 | A required merge value is empty, for example no ADDRESS row in `v_ace_contact` for the person | Notice held with the field named; task to the case owner | MSG-P6-007 | AC3 |
| X3 | The current version is withdrawn | Notice held; task to the litigation officer | MSG-P6-003 | AC4 |
| X4 | The decision log write fails | Nothing stored; incident raised | MSG-P7-003 | AC5 |
| X5 | The same request arrives twice on one business date | The first notice is returned; no second notice | None | AC6 |
| X6 | The ACE account batch is stale | Generation proceeds with the ACE business date shown; the decision log entry records it | MSG-P1-001 | AC7 |
| X7 | The person is not on the case | Refused | MSG-P4-003 | AC8 |
| X8 | `v_ace_pod` holds no row for the notice reference | The notice shows as generated with no delivery confirmation; the delivery matcher of RWB-E1-055 lists it | None | TC-E1-052-11 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Needs the catalog (RWB-E1-046), the case links (RWB-E1-018), the ACE views (RWB-E1-069) and the decision log writer (RWB-E1-027); no screen and no dispatch |
| Negotiable | Which notice types and products have templates is data; the merge and the checks are fixed |
| Valuable | Ends re-keying of demand, recall and guarantor notices, and the address is the one ACE holds |
| Estimable | One service, one renderer, one published interface, four view reads |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion is a service test with synthetic cases, templates and view rows |

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | A notice is generated only from the current Approved template for its notice type, product group and language | R-LIT-03; CTL-14 |
| BR2 | A withdrawn template holds generation and raises a task to the litigation officer | R-LIT-04 |
| BR3 | A required merge value that is empty holds the notice, names the field and raises a task to the case owner | merge_field.is_required; pattern of R-RES-36 |
| BR4 | The footer carries the case number, template code, template version and generation date | REQ-OCC-001; CTL-14 evidence |
| BR5 | The generated PDF is a write-once document on the case | CTL-12; DT06 |
| BR6 | A notice that cannot be written to the decision log is not generated | Principle 5; R-UNI-39; CTL-06 |
| BR7 | Sent type is NPL for a case at 90 days past due or more | LOV-SENT-TYPE; DL16 |
| BR8 | One notice per case, notice type, `person_key` and business date | R-UNI-40; notice.person_key (DF-LEG-030) |
| BR9 | The party, the customer name and the notice address are read from `v_ace_customer` and `v_ace_contact` by `person_key` and the composite `contact_key` (`contact_type:key`). The Workbench holds no party or contact copy | D-RCV-35 U4; ADR-010; Data Tier Map section 5 |
| BR10 | A merge code resolves to a view column or a P3 or P5 field. The clear `identification_number` is never a merge source because it never leaves ACE; `v_ace_customer` exposes `id_no_masked` and `id_no_last4` only | ADR-010; Data Tier Map section 7; DF-ACE-073 |
| BR11 | Proof of delivery is read from `v_ace_pod` by `notice_ref`; the Workbench writes no WIN delivery fact | Data Tier Map section 3; RWB-E1-055 |
| BR12 | The merge snapshot holds the merge code, the view column, the business key and the field ID of each value used, never the value | NFR-040; guardrail on personal data |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It sets the notice state (standard column state):

| From | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | Generate | Template Approved and all required merge values present | Generated |
| None | Generate | A required merge value empty | Held |
| None | TEMPLATE_WITHDRAWN | Template state Withdrawn | Held |

### 12. Contract

No endpoint in Epic 1. POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/notices calls the same service from RWB-E2-021.

**Published interface NoticeApi** (P6)

```java
public interface NoticeApi {
    NoticeResult generate(NoticeGenerationRequest request)
        throws TemplateNotApprovedException, PartyNotOnCaseException, DecisionNotRecordedException;
}
public record NoticeGenerationRequest(UUID caseId, String noticeType, String personKey,
                                      String language, UUID requestedBy, LocalDate businessDate) {}
public record NoticeResult(UUID noticeId, String state, UUID documentId, String holdReason,
                           int templateVersion, List<String> messageCodes) {}
```

Calls out of the module, each through the owner's published interface:

```java
CaseSummary CaseWorkflowApi.getCaseSummary(UUID caseId);                       // P3
List<CasePartyView> CaseWorkflowApi.getCaseParties(UUID caseId);               // P3
UUID CaseWorkflowApi.raiseTask(UUID caseId, String taskCode, String ownerRole, String reasonCode); // P3
// P1, RWB-E1-016; every method reads recovery.v_ace_*
Optional<AceCustomerView> AceSourceQuery.customer(String personKey);           // v_ace_customer
List<AceContactView> AceSourceQuery.contacts(String personKey, String contactType); // v_ace_contact
Optional<AceAccountView> AceSourceQuery.account(String accountKey);            // v_ace_account
Optional<AcePodView> AceSourceQuery.podForNotice(String noticeRef);            // v_ace_pod, Tier 2
DocumentRef DocumentHubApi.storeGenerated(UUID caseId, String personKey, String documentType, byte[] pdf); // P5
DecisionLogRef DecisionLogApi.write(DecisionLogRequest request) throws DecisionLogWriteException;    // P7
```

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Event published | NoticeGenerated (EV-13): noticeId, caseId, type, templateVersion, written to the outbox in the same transaction |
| Idempotency key | caseId, noticeType, personKey and business date (unique index) |
| Order of writes | Decision log entry first, then document, notice row and outbox in one transaction; a failed document store rolls back the notice and the decision log entry is followed by a correcting entry under R-UNI-24 |

### 13. Solution plan

- Package: folder `recovery/comms/notices`, Java package `recovery.comms.notices`.

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| NoticeEntity | Entity | Maps table notice with the new columns |
| NoticeRepository | Repository | Reads and writes notice; finds by the idempotency key |
| NoticeGenerationService | Published interface | Implements NoticeApi: steps 2 to 9 of the flow |
| MergeValueResolver | Service | For each merge code, calls the P3, P1 or P5 interface named by merge_field.source_entity and reads the view column named by merge_field.source_field |
| AceSourceReader | Repository | Reads `v_ace_customer`, `v_ace_contact`, `v_ace_account` and `v_ace_pod` by business key; SELECT only |
| LetterRenderer | Service | Fills the DOCX body and renders PDF with the footer |
| NoticeGeneratedPublisher | Service | Writes NoticeGenerated to the outbox |

- Database: table notice (Physical Schema v6) carries `person_key`, `template_id` and `hold_reason`; this story adds unique index ux_notice_generation on (case_id, notice_type, person_key, (created_at::date)) and the check constraint on state in ('GENERATED','HELD','APPROVED','SENT','DELIVERED','UNSERVED'). Flyway migration `V1_052__notice_generation.sql` adds the index and the check. No party or contact copy is added.
- Configuration and reference data: templates and merge field catalog (RWB-E1-046, Legal counsel); LOV-NOTICE, LOV-SENT-TYPE; LOV-DOC-TYPE value for a generated notice from the document checklist (data steward); task code "Complete notice data" as a task row of the case model (center of excellence). The renderer uses the ACE document rendering library, or docx4j with PDF export where ACE has none (dependency approval under NFR-054).
- Build steps:
  1. Write the migration and NoticeEntity; test the unique index and the state check.
  2. Build AceSourceReader over the four views by `person_key`, `contact_key` and `account_key`; test the reads and the missing rows.
  3. Build MergeValueResolver with the view columns and the P3 fields; test every merge code in the synthetic catalog and the empty required value.
  4. Build LetterRenderer; test the merged text and the footer of AC1 from a synthetic DOCX.
  5. Build NoticeGenerationService with the template check, hold paths and task raise; test AC2, AC3, AC4, AC8.
  6. Add the decision log write before the document store and the rollback path; test AC5.
  7. Add the idempotency key and the stale data handling; test AC6 and AC7.
  8. Add the outbox write of NoticeGenerated and the proof of delivery read; test AC1 and AC9.
- Feature flag: `rwb.comms.notice-generation`. Proof of delivery reads a Section B view, so that part is on only after RWB-ACE-001 lands and V0003 creates `v_ace_pod` (DL43).
- Done when: the tests in section 16 pass, and a generated PDF from the synthetic set opens in a standard PDF reader with Thai text rendered.

### 14. Validation and messages

| ID | When | Message |
|---|---|---|
| MSG-P6-005 | The template has no Approved version | {template} version {version} has no Legal approval. It cannot be used. |
| MSG-P6-007 | A required merge value is empty | {notice} for case {case} is on hold. {field} has no value on the case. |
| MSG-P6-003 | The template is withdrawn | The {template} template has been withdrawn. The notice is on hold until Legal approves a new version. |
| MSG-P7-003 | The decision log write failed | The action was not taken because the decision could not be recorded. Try again in a few minutes. |
| MSG-P1-001 | The ACE account batch is stale | {product} is from {date}. Today's ACE batch has not arrived. |
| MSG-P4-003 | The person is not on the case | This case is not in your scope. |

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: notice types, templates, merge codes, task codes and the sent type mapping are data.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts. The name and address reach the PDF only; the decision log holds a reference to the merge snapshot, and the snapshot holds the view column, the business key and the field ID of each value, never the value.
- ACE data only through the `recovery.v_ace_*` views: the customer, the contact point, the account balance and the delivery facts come from `v_ace_customer`, `v_ace_contact`, `v_ace_account` and `v_ace_pod`. The recovery schema holds no foreign key into a `public` table.
- The clear identity number never leaves ACE and is never merged into a notice.
- The generated PDF is never overwritten; a correction is a new notice.
- PII Kafka receives one access event per personal field read, through RWB-E1-039.

### 19. Out of scope

- Dispatch to WIN and proof of delivery capture (RWB-E1-055, RWB-E2-021); the delivery facts are read from `v_ace_pod`.
- Approval of demand and recall notices before dispatch (RWB-E2-014).
- The endpoint for a person to request a notice (RWB-E2-021).
- The litigation route rules that call generation in production (R-LIT-01 to R-LIT-03, Epic 5, DL24).
- Contract, credit approval and mortgage documents (RWB-E2-026).

## RWB-E1-053 Field extraction for the six types into the index

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-053 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-09 Extract fields from the six document types |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-006, REQ-DCM-001 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.5 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | D7.2 |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-049, RWB-E1-050, RWB-E1-025 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **case owner**, I want **the key fields of each of the six document types extracted and written to the document index with a confidence per field**, so that **documents are searchable by their content**.

### 2. Business rationale

Court dates, case numbers, appraisal values and title numbers are typed by hand from paper today, and a document is found only by the person who filed it. This story reads the agreed fields of each classified intake item and each uploaded document into the index with a confidence score, so the case owner and the litigation officer find a document by its content, the attach step finds the case from the extracted case number, and the low-confidence values go to a person. It meets REQ-DCM-006 and REQ-DCM-001 and feeds the module measure "fields extracted without review", which is to rise each month.

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-049 (OCR text per page through OcrOutputReader) and RWB-E1-050 (predicted_type and classification on the intake item) are done.
- RWB-E1-025 is done: DOCTYPE-2026.11 is in force with the six types and 26 fields, read through DocumentTypeCatalog. Each entry of field_definitions holds name, data_type, personal, extraction_method (TEMPLATE or MODEL), review_only and an optional pattern (keys recorded in the additions file).
- RWB-E1-024 is done: DocumentStore.store writes the fields passed in StoreRequest as document_field rows.
- Rows in document_hub_parameter: EXTRACT_FIELD_THRESHOLD 0.80; EXTRACT_PRECISION_PASS 0.90; EXTRACT_RECALL_PASS 0.90; EXTRACT_MAX_ATTEMPTS 3; EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 60; BE_YEAR_OFFSET 543. Values assumed until the RWB-E1-060 report (DL11).
- The labeled sample of 180 synthetic documents, 30 per type, holds the true value of every field.
- The step runs as SY-OCR (Documents CRU). Feature flag rwb.dochub.extract is on.

### 4. Flow

1. JOB-12 Document intake: runs extractStep after classifyStep and before matchStep.
2. ExtractStep: selects intake items with ocr_status DONE and extract_status PENDING that are classified with no review_reason, or that carry a document ID with a given type (uploads), locking each row.
3. ExtractStep: reads the field definitions of the type from the version of DocumentTypeCatalog in force, the threshold and the attempts.
4. ExtractStep: reads the page text and layout through OcrOutputReader.
5. FieldExtractor: the extractor named by extraction_method returns a raw value and a confidence per field, with the extractor version.
6. ValueNormalizer: converts each value to its data type: Thai and English dates to ISO dates, Buddhist Era years less BE_YEAR_OFFSET, Thai digits to Arabic digits, amounts to numeric(18,2) baht.
7. ExtractStep: sets each field to state OK, or REVIEW when the confidence is below the threshold, the value cannot be converted, the value fails its pattern, or the field is review_only.
8. ExtractStep: for an item with no document, writes the fields to document_intake.extracted_fields and sets extract_status DONE; matchStep (RWB-E1-032) passes them to DocumentStore.store, which writes the document_field rows and sets review_status PENDING when a field is in REVIEW.
9. ExtractStep: for an item with a document, writes the document_field rows directly, sets document.review_status PENDING when a field is in REVIEW, and writes DocumentFieldsExtracted (EV-17) to the outbox in the same transaction.
10. Case owner: opens SCR-30 Case documents and sees the fields with their confidence; a document with review_status PENDING shows MSG-P5-003.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | A field confidence is below the threshold | Field state REVIEW; document review_status PENDING when stored | MSG-P5-003 | AC3, AC5 |
| X2 | The field is review_only in the type table | Field state REVIEW whatever its confidence | MSG-P5-003 | AC4 |
| X3 | A value cannot be converted to its data type | Raw value kept, confidence 0.0000, state REVIEW | MSG-P5-003 | AC6 |
| X4 | The extractor does not answer within the timeout on every attempt | extract_status FAILED; review_reason EXTRACTION_FAILED; no fields; item in the review queue | MSG-P5-003 | AC8 |
| X5 | The job runs again over extracted items | Not extracted again; no second set of fields | None | AC9 |
| X6 | Two workers start on the same item | The row lock lets one worker take it; the other skips it | None | AC10 |
| X7 | A new version of an uploaded document is added | New rows for the new version; old rows inactive and readable | None | AC11 |
| X8 | A user reads a document outside their scope | 404 | MSG-P4-003 | AC13 |
| X9 | A user without Documents R reads the document | 403 | MSG-P4-002 | Access test TC-E1-053-14 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Adds one step to JOB-12 after the OCR and classification steps of Epic 1 |
| Negotiable | Fields, thresholds, methods, patterns and review-only flags are data |
| Valuable | Ends re-keying of court dates, case numbers and appraisal values from paper |
| Estimable | One job step, an extractor interface with two implementations, a normalizer, an evaluation runner |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each scenario below is one test with synthetic data |

### 7. Acceptance criteria

```gherkin

  Scenario: AC1 Fields extracted
```

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | The fields extracted are those listed for the type in the document type table version in force on the business date | DocumentTypeCatalog (RWB-E1-025); DL19; R-UNI-38 |
| BR2 | A field at or above the threshold has state OK; below it has state REVIEW | EXTRACT_FIELD_THRESHOLD, 0.80 assumed; DL11 |
| BR3 | A review_only field has state REVIEW whatever its confidence | field_definitions.review_only; FEAT-AGT-04 |
| BR4 | A field whose precision or recall on the labeled sample is below the pass mark is proposed as review-only; it takes effect only through an approved load | CTL-08; Principle 1 |
| BR5 | A value that cannot be converted or fails its pattern has state REVIEW with confidence 0.0000 for the conversion case | field_definitions.data_type and pattern |
| BR6 | Dates are stored as ISO dates; a Buddhist Era year is converted by subtracting BE_YEAR_OFFSET; amounts in baht with two decimals | BE_YEAR_OFFSET 543 |
| BR7 | An extractor that does not answer within the timeout is retried up to the attempt limit; then the item goes to review with no partial fields | R-UNI-32; EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, EXTRACT_MAX_ATTEMPTS |
| BR8 | An item already extracted for the table version is not extracted again | R-UNI-40 |
| BR9 | A personal field value is masked in every response unless the role may see it, and never logged | DF-DOC-015; CTL-11; DL26 |
| BR10 | Extraction never changes the stored file, so a write-once document is not altered | CTL-12 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It sets document_intake.extract_status (PENDING to DONE or FAILED), document_field.state (OK or REVIEW) and, for attached documents, document.review_status (NOT_NEEDED to PENDING).

| RW-CASEOWN, case owner | Reads the document and its fields in scope (Documents R) |
| RW-LITOFF, litigation officer | Reads the document and its fields in scope (Documents R) |
| RW-COE, center of excellence analyst | Reads the evaluation report; prepares the review-only proposal |
| RW-REFADM, reference data administrator | Loads a new DOCTYPE version (Reference data CRUD) |
| Business lead with Legal | Approves the type and field list (DL19) |

### 12. Contract

**Job step**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Job name | JOB-12 Document intake; this story adds extractStep after classifyStep |
| Schedule | Every 15 minutes in business hours |
| Input | Intake items with ocr_status DONE and extract_status PENDING that are classified with no review_reason, or that carry a document with a given type |
| Output | extracted_fields and extract_status on the item; document_field rows and review_status for attached documents; counts on the job record |
| Events published | DocumentFieldsExtracted (EV-17) for attached documents, payload documentId, field names and confidence; no values |
| Idempotency key | Intake item ID and table version; an item with extract_status DONE or FAILED is not read again |
| Restart | Unfinished items stay PENDING and are taken by the next run |

**Published interface (P5, used by RWB-E1-032 and RWB-E1-054)**

```java
package recovery.dochub.extract;
public interface FieldExtraction {
    ExtractionResult extractIntake(UUID intakeId);                         // used by extractStep and by a type change in review
    List<ExtractedField> fieldsForIntake(UUID intakeId);                    // fieldName, value, extractedValue, confidence, state, extractorVersion, personal
}
```

**Endpoint read:** GET /api/recovery/v1/documents/{documentId}, response Document extended with fields as recorded by RWB-E1-024. Errors 401; 403 no Documents R (MSG-P4-002); 404 not found or out of scope (MSG-P4-003); 503 (MSG-GEN-006). Authorization Documents, right R, scope applied.

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** folder `recovery/dochub/extract`, Java package `recovery.dochub.extract`.

**Components**

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| ExtractStep | Job | Step of JOB-12: select with SKIP LOCKED, extract, set states, write |
| FieldExtraction | Published interface | Section 12 |
| FieldExtractionService | Service | Applies BR1 to BR8 for one item in one transaction |
| FieldExtractor | Service (interface) | extract(pages, fieldDefinitions, timeout) returns raw value and confidence per field |
| TemplateFieldExtractor | Service | Layout and anchor-text extractor for extraction_method TEMPLATE |
| ModelFieldExtractor | Service | Calls the model through the P10 model gateway (RWB-TE-013) for extraction_method MODEL, with masked text as in RWB-E1-050 |
| ValueNormalizer | Service | Dates, Buddhist Era years, Thai digits, amounts (BR6) and pattern checks (BR5) |
| ExtractionEvaluationRunner | Service | Runs the labeled sample; writes evaluation/extraction/{runDate}.json and the proposed load file |
| DocumentIntakeRepository | Repository | From RWB-E1-049; adds the extraction columns |
| DocumentFieldRepository | Repository | Writes document_field for attached documents |

**Database**

- Flyway migration `V1_5_053__extraction.sql`: adds to document_intake extracted_fields jsonb, extract_status varchar(12) default 'PENDING', extract_attempts integer default 0; adds to document_field extracted_value varchar(1000) and extractor_version varchar(40).
- Index `ix_intake_extract ON document_intake (extract_status) WHERE ocr_status = 'DONE'`; unique index `ux_document_field_active ON document_field (document_id, field_name) WHERE is_active`.
- DocumentStore.store (RWB-E1-024) copies extracted_value, extractor_version and state from the StoreRequest fields into document_field.

**Configuration and reference data**

- DOCTYPE-2026.11 field definitions (RWB-E1-025) with extraction_method, review_only and pattern, loaded by RW-REFADM and approved by the business lead with Legal (DL19).
- document_hub_parameter rows EXTRACT_FIELD_THRESHOLD, EXTRACT_PRECISION_PASS, EXTRACT_RECALL_PASS, EXTRACT_MAX_ATTEMPTS, EXTRACT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, BE_YEAR_OFFSET (values assumed; DL11).
- Property rwb.dochub.extract.model-route for the gateway route (DL33).

**Build steps**

1. Write the migration and the indexes; repository tests.
2. Build ValueNormalizer with unit tests for Thai and English dates, Buddhist Era years, Thai digits, amounts, patterns and the invalid date of AC6.
3. Build FieldExtractor, TemplateFieldExtractor and ModelFieldExtractor against fixed OCR pages; timeout and attempts on the model path.
4. Build FieldExtractionService and ExtractStep with SKIP LOCKED selection and the skip rules; test AC8 to AC10.
5. Write fields to extracted_fields for unattached items and to document_field for attached items with the outbox event; test AC1, AC3 and AC11.
6. Check with RWB-E1-024 that StoreRequest fields carry state, extracted_value and extractor_version, and that the store sets review_status PENDING when a field is in REVIEW.
7. Build ExtractionEvaluationRunner; run the 180-document sample in SIT and attach the report.

**Feature flag:** `rwb.dochub.extract`. Off: extractStep sets extract_status DONE with no fields, and items continue to matchStep with the OCR text only.

**Done when:** the tests in section 16 pass and the evaluation report for the 180 sample documents is attached to the story.

### 17. Guardrails

## RWB-E1-054 Review queue for low-confidence documents

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-054 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P5 Document hub |
| Feature | FEAT-DCM-10 Send a low-confidence extraction to the review queue; FEAT-DCM-11 Check a low-confidence extraction |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-DCM-005 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, section 3.5 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | None |
| Priority | Must |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-049, RWB-E1-035, RWB-E1-050, RWB-E1-053, RWB-E1-032 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **litigation officer**, I want **a queue of documents with low classification or extraction confidence, each correctable in one screen, with the correction fed back to the labeled set**, so that **no document is attached wrongly and the models improve**.

### 2. Business rationale

A wrong type or a wrong hearing date on a court notice puts the wrong date on the case and the litigation timers run from it. This story shows in one queue every intake item the pipeline could not type, read or match, and every stored document with a field below its threshold; one officer confirms or corrects the type, the case and the fields on one screen, and each correction is kept as a labeled example for the model evaluations. It meets REQ-DCM-005 and moves the measure "fields extracted without review", because each correction improves the next model version.

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-049, RWB-E1-050, RWB-E1-053 and RWB-E1-032 are done: intake items carry review_reason (LOW_CONFIDENCE, UNKNOWN_TYPE, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, RESCAN, UNREADABLE_FILE, EXTRACTION_FAILED, NO_MATCH, MULTIPLE, CONFLICT, CASE_CLOSED), candidates, candidate cases and extracted fields; stored documents carry review_status PENDING when a field is in REVIEW.
- RWB-E1-024 is done: DocumentStore.store writes the document, its fields and the DOCATT decision log entry.
- RWB-E1-035 shows documents on the case record view.
- Rows in document_hub_parameter: REVIEW_TEAM_UNATTACHED "DOC-SVC" (assumed), REVIEW_DATE_MIN 2000-01-01, REVIEW_DATE_MAX 2100-12-31, REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE 50.
- The officer holds RW-LITOFF (Documents CRU) with team scope. Feature flag rwb.dochub.review is on.

### 4. Flow

1. Litigation officer: opens SCR-31 Document review queue.
2. System: lists, oldest first, the intake items with a review_reason and no case that belong to the officer's review team, the intake items whose candidate cases are in the officer's scope, and the stored documents with review_status PENDING on cases in scope; each row shows the reason, the proposed type, the two candidates, confidence and age.
3. Litigation officer: opens an item; the system shows the file, the OCR text, the type with its candidates, the candidate cases and the fields, with fields in REVIEW marked.
4. Litigation officer: keeps the type or chooses another type from the list in force; a new type re-runs extraction for that type and shows the new fields.
5. Litigation officer: chooses the case from the candidates, or enters a case number that the system looks up through CaseDirectory.
6. Litigation officer: confirms each marked field with Confirm, or enters the value with Correct; the system checks it against the field data type and range.
7. Litigation officer: chooses Attach; the system calls DocumentStore.store with the case, the type and the fields, which writes the document, its fields and the DOCATT decision log entry, and stores a legal type in the write-once container.
8. System: sets the intake item review_outcome ATTACHED and the document review_status CONFIRMED (nothing changed) or CORRECTED (type, case or a value changed), and writes DocumentFieldsExtracted (EV-17).
9. Litigation officer: for a stored document with a field in REVIEW, confirms or corrects the field and completes the review with POST review.
10. Center of excellence analyst: the model evaluations (RWB-E1-060) read the resolved items through LabeledSetReader.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | Correct is chosen with an empty value | 422; nothing saved | MSG-GEN-001 | AC4 |
| X2 | The chosen type is not in the type list in force | 422; nothing saved | MSG-P5-006 | AC5 |
| X3 | A corrected date is outside the allowed range | 422; nothing saved | MSG-GEN-002 | AC6 |
| X4 | Attach or complete with a field still in REVIEW | 422; nothing stored | MSG-GEN-001 | AC7 |
| X5 | The chosen case is closed | 422; nothing stored | MSG-P5-005 | AC8 |
| X6 | Another officer saved the same item first | 409; the officer reloads | MSG-GEN-004 | AC9 |
| X7 | The same file is already on the chosen case | The item is linked to the existing document; no second document | MSG-P5-024 | AC11 |
| X8 | Discard without a reason | 422 | MSG-GEN-001 | AC13 |
| X9 | No item in the officer's queue | Empty state on SCR-31 | None | AC15 |
| X10 | A document outside the officer's scope | 404 | MSG-P4-003 | AC16 |
| X11 | The same confirmation is sent twice | Second call returns the saved field; nothing changes | None | AC17 |
| X12 | The user holds Documents R only | 403 | MSG-P4-002 | Access test TC-E1-054-18 |
| X13 | The decision log write fails on attach | Nothing stored; item unchanged; incident raised | MSG-P7-003 | Principle 5 test TC-E1-054-19 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Works on the review items the Epic 1 pipeline steps already produce; stores through RWB-E1-024 |
| Negotiable | The review team, date limits and the type list are data; the layout follows the ACE components (DL31) |
| Valuable | No low-confidence or unmatched document reaches a case without a person checking it |
| Estimable | One queue endpoint, three intake endpoints, the existing field endpoint, one review endpoint, one screen |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each scenario below is one test with synthetic data |

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | The queue holds intake items with a review_reason and no outcome, and documents with review_status PENDING | RWB-E1-049, RWB-E1-050, RWB-E1-053, RWB-E1-032; LOV-REVIEW |
| BR2 | An item with no case is shown to the review team named in REVIEW_TEAM_UNATTACHED and to roles with scope All; an item with candidate cases and a document are shown by case scope | Permission matrix scope; CTL-09; REVIEW_TEAM_UNATTACHED (DOC-SVC assumed) |
| BR3 | Attach and complete are allowed only when no field is in REVIEW, the type is in force and the case is open | LOV-REVIEW; DocumentTypeCatalog; DF-CAS-005 |
| BR4 | review_status becomes CONFIRMED when type, case and values are kept, CORRECTED when any changes | LOV-REVIEW |
| BR5 | A corrected value keeps the extracted value in extracted_value and the corrector in confirmed_by | DF-DOC-017; FEAT-DCM-11 |
| BR6 | Attach stores through DocumentStore, which writes the DOCATT decision log entry first and places a legal type in the write-once container | RWB-E1-024; Principle 5; CTL-12 |
| BR7 | Each resolved item is a labeled example for the model evaluations | FEAT-AGT-04; FEAT-DCM-11 |
| BR8 | A change saved against an old version is refused | Optimistic lock column version; MSG-GEN-004 |
| BR9 | A discarded item keeps its file in the intake container and records the reason and the person | REQ-DCM-019 (never removed silently) |
| BR10 | Field values are masked unless the role may see them | DF-DOC-015; CTL-11; DL26 |

### 9. State transitions

None. This story does not change a case status. It sets document_intake.review_outcome (ATTACHED or DISCARDED), document.review_status (PENDING to CONFIRMED or CORRECTED) and document_field.state (REVIEW to CONFIRMED or CORRECTED).

| From | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intake item with review_reason | Attach | BR3 passes; store succeeds | review_outcome ATTACHED |
| Intake item with review_reason | Discard | Reason given | review_outcome DISCARDED |
| document.review_status PENDING | Review completed | Nothing changed | CONFIRMED |
| document.review_status PENDING | Review completed | A value changed | CORRECTED |

### 10. Authority

| Who | What they may do in this story |
|---|---|
| RW-LITOFF, litigation officer | Lists, reads, corrects, attaches and discards review items in scope (Documents CRU) |
| RW-CASEOWN, case owner | Lists, reads, corrects and attaches review items of own cases (Documents CRU) |
| RW-TEAMMGR, team manager | Reads the queue for the team (Documents R); cannot correct or attach |
| SY-OCR, OCR and extraction pipeline | Re-runs extraction on a type change (Documents CRU) |
| SY-DECLOG, decision log writer | Writes the DOCATT entry through DocumentStore |
| RW-COE, center of excellence analyst | Reads the labeled examples through the model evaluations (Documents R) |

### 12. Contract

**GET /review-items** (new, recorded in the additions file)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | Query kind (INTAKE, DOCUMENT or ALL; default ALL), reason, page, size (default REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE) |
| Response | ReviewItemPage: items of kind, intakeId or documentId, caseNo, reason, predictedType, candidates, confidence, receivedAt, version |
| Errors | 401 (MSG-P4-001); 403 no Documents R (MSG-P4-002); 422 unknown kind or reason (MSG-GEN-002); 503 (MSG-GEN-006) |
| Authorization | Documents, right R, scope applied (BR2) |
| Idempotency | Not applicable |

**GET /intake-items/{intakeItemId}** and **GET /intake-items/{intakeItemId}/content** (new)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Response | IntakeItem: id, source, receivedAt, reviewReason, predictedType, candidates, candidateCases (caseNo, status), pages (page number, text), fields (masked by role), version; content returns the file |
| Errors | 401; 403 (MSG-P4-002); 404 not found or not in the review scope (MSG-P4-003); 503 (MSG-GEN-006) |
| Authorization | Documents, right R |

**POST /intake-items/{intakeItemId}/resolve** (new)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | ResolveRequest: action (SET_TYPE, ATTACH or DISCARD), documentType, caseNo, fields (fieldName, value, confirmed), discardReason, version; header Idempotency-Key |
| Response | IntakeItem for SET_TYPE and DISCARD; Document for ATTACH |
| Errors | 401; 403 no Documents U (MSG-P4-002); 404 (MSG-P4-003); 409 stale version or item already resolved (MSG-GEN-004); 422 type not in force (MSG-P5-006), case closed (MSG-P5-005), field in review or empty value or empty reason (MSG-GEN-001), date out of range (MSG-GEN-002); 503 decision log write failed (MSG-P7-003) |
| Authorization | Documents, right U, scope applied |
| Idempotency | Idempotency-Key header; a repeat returns the first result |

**PATCH /api/recovery/v1/documents/{documentId}/fields/{fieldId}**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Request | FieldReview: value (required when confirmed is false), confirmed; header If-Match with the document version |
| Response | DocumentField |
| Errors | 401; 403 (MSG-P4-002); 404 (MSG-P4-003); 409 stale version (MSG-GEN-004); 422 empty value (MSG-GEN-001) or out of range (MSG-GEN-002); 503 (MSG-GEN-006) |
| Authorization | Documents, right U, scope applied |
| Idempotency | A repeat with the same value and flag returns the saved field without change |

**POST /documents/{documentId}/review** (new): request DocumentReviewRequest action COMPLETE and version; response Document; 409 (MSG-GEN-004); 422 field still in review (MSG-GEN-001); Documents, right U. RWB-E2-017 uses the same action for generated drafts.

### 13. Solution plan

**Package.** folder `recovery/dochub/review`, Java package `recovery.dochub.review`.

**Components**

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| ReviewQueueController | Controller | GET /review-queue, GET /document-intake/{intakeId}, content, POST resolve, POST /documents/{documentId}/review |
| DocumentHubController | Controller | PATCH /documents/{documentId}/fields/{fieldId} |
| ReviewQueueService | Service | Builds the queue with the scope rule BR2 |
| ReviewResolutionService | Service | SET_TYPE, ATTACH and DISCARD for intake items; field confirm and correct; complete for documents (BR3 to BR9) |
| LabeledSetReader | Published interface | Resolved items as labeled examples |
| DocumentIntakeRepository | Repository | From RWB-E1-049; adds the outcome columns |
| ReviewQueuePage | React component | SCR-31 list, paging and empty state |
| ReviewItemPanel | React component | File and OCR text viewer, type chooser with candidates, case chooser, fields with Confirm and Correct, Attach and Discard |

**Database**

- Flyway migration `V1_5_054__review_outcome.sql` adds to document_intake: review_outcome varchar(12), resolved_by uuid, resolved_at timestamptz, discard_reason varchar(400).
- Index `ix_intake_review ON document_intake (received_at) WHERE review_reason IS NOT NULL AND review_outcome IS NULL`; index `ix_document_review ON document (review_status, created_at) WHERE review_status = 'PENDING'`.

**Configuration and reference data**

- document_hub_parameter rows REVIEW_TEAM_UNATTACHED, REVIEW_DATE_MIN, REVIEW_DATE_MAX, REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE (values assumed; DL11), loaded by the reference data administrator.
- DOCTYPE version in force through DocumentTypeCatalog (RWB-E1-025; DL19).

**Build steps**

1. Write the migration and the indexes; repository tests.
2. Build ReviewQueueService with the scope rule and ordering; test AC14 and AC15.
3. Build the intake item read and content endpoints with masking; test AC16 and the access test.
4. Build SET_TYPE with the call to FieldExtraction; test AC5 and AC10.
5. Build field confirm and correct with validation and the If-Match check; test AC3, AC4, AC6, AC9 and AC17.
6. Build ATTACH through DocumentStore.store with BR3, the duplicate link and the outcome; test AC2, AC7, AC8, AC11 and the decision log failure.
7. Build DISCARD; test AC12 and AC13. Build LabeledSetReader.
8. Build ReviewQueuePage and ReviewItemPanel on SCR-31 with the Loading, list, reviewed and empty states; browser tests (RWB-TE-010).

**Feature flag:** `rwb.dochub.review`. Off: SCR-31 is hidden and review items stay in the queue untouched.

**Done when:** the tests in section 16 pass and SCR-31 passes the browser and accessibility tests of RWB-TE-010.

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: the review team, date limits, page size and the type list come from document_hub_parameter and the type table.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts: field values and OCR text are masked by role and never logged; the labeled examples stay inside the bank.
- No read of another module's tables: cases come through CaseDirectory; scope comes from the ACE common access check.
- Attach goes only through DocumentStore, so a document never exists without its decision log entry.

## RWB-E1-055 Proof of delivery capture design with WIN

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Story key | RWB-E1-055 |
| Epic | E1, release 30 November 2026 |
| Module | P6 Communications |
| Feature | FEAT-DRI-17 Capture proof of delivery from WIN |
| Requirement IDs | REQ-OCC-003, REQ-ILG-004 |
| BRD section | Business Requirements Epic 1, sections 3.6 and 4; Business Requirements Epic 2, section 4 |
| L3 process | 13 Manage documents and correspondence |
| Decision | D7.1 |
| Priority | Should |
| Depends on | RWB-E1-052, RWB-E1-054, RWB-E1-028, RWB-E1-066 |
| Status | Ready for build |

### 1. Story

As a **litigation officer (RW-LITOFF)**, I want **generated notices sent to WIN for print and registered mail, with the dispatch and the proof of delivery written back on the notice**, so that **the case shows what was sent and when it arrived**.

### 2. Business rationale

Proof of delivery is chased by phone today, and a notice period counted from the print date can be challenged in court. This story writes the daily WIN notice file (INT-14) and reads back the WIN barcode and the weekly proof of delivery that ACE ingests into `pod_receipt`, through `v_ace_pod` by `notice_ref`. It publishes the delivery so the notice period timer starts from the delivery date (CTL-15). It serves REQ-OCC-003 and REQ-ILG-004 and the FSD P6 measure "notices with proof of delivery, 100 percent", and fixes the interface contract with WIN that RWB-E2-021 completes. The Workbench writes no WIN delivery fact of its own: ACE holds the proof of delivery, as it holds every other source record (D-RCV-35 U1).

### 3. Preconditions

- RWB-E1-052 is done: notices are generated in state Generated with a stored PDF.
- RWB-E1-028 is done: P3 starts a NOTICE_PERIOD timer when it consumes NoticeDelivered.
- RWB-E1-066 is done: the interaction ledger accepts entries through its writer.
- RWB-E1-054 is done: held records reach a review list.
- The integration adapters (P2) send and receive WIN files on the SFTP path agreed with the WIN owner.
- The dispatch-eligible notice states are configured: Generated in Epic 1.
- JOB-10 is listed in the job monitor with its run book (RWB-E1-056).
- v_ace_pod is a Section B view over the ACE table pod_receipt, so the proof of delivery steps stay behind their flag until RWB-ACE-001 lands (DL43).

### 4. Flow

1. JOB-10 WIN outbound notices, daily 16:00: selects notices in a dispatch-eligible state with no sent date.
2. System: builds one INT-14 file: ContractNO of the case's primary account, addressee, address read from `v_ace_contact` by `person_key`, notice type, template version and document reference; writes the trailer with the record count.
3. System: hands the file to the integration adapters and marks each notice "file sent" with the file ID.
4. Integration adapters: deliver the WIN acknowledgment, which carries per ContractNO the sent date (DDMMYYYY), Barcode and Sent Type (s2t mapping of INT-14).
5. System: sets notice state Sent with sent_date, barcode and sent_type; writes a LETTER entry to the interaction ledger; publishes NoticeDispatched.
6. System: reads the WIN proof of delivery that ACE ingested into `pod_receipt`, through `v_ace_pod`, for the notice's business date.
7. System: matches each `v_ace_pod` row to a notice by barcode, then by `notice_ref`; sets callback_date and delivery_status from the row, and state Delivered.
8. System: writes the delivery to the interaction ledger and publishes NoticeDelivered with the delivery date; P3 starts the notice period timer from that date.
9. System: each day, compares notices sent to WIN with barcodes returned (REC-05) and lists any notice with no barcode three days after sending for the platform administrator.

### 5. Exception paths

| ID | Trigger | What happens | Message | Covered by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | WIN does not acknowledge the file | Notices stay Generated with file sent; the next JOB-10 run sends them again; after the third failure a task goes to the owning team | MSG-GEN-006 | AC4 |
| X2 | The ACE batch for source WIN is not COMPLETE for the business date | No `v_ace_pod` row of that date is read; earlier delivery data stays; the notice data product shows stale | MSG-P1-001 | AC5 |
| X3 | A `v_ace_pod` row names an unknown barcode and notice_ref | The row is held on the exception list; the rest are read | None | AC6 |
| X4 | The same `v_ace_pod` row is read twice | One delivery is recorded and the repeat is counted | None | AC7 |
| X5 | JOB-10 runs twice on one day | No notice is written to a second file | None | AC8 |
| X6 | No barcode three days after sending | REC-05 break listed for the platform administrator | None | AC9 |
| X7 | A later `v_ace_pod` row repeats a delivery already recorded | Ignored and counted | None | AC10 |
| X8 | The WIN batch is one business day late | The notice data product shows as stale | MSG-P1-001 | AC11 |

### 6. INVEST check

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| Independent | Uses generated notices (RWB-E1-052) and the P3 timer consumer (RWB-E1-028); refused and undeliverable results come in RWB-E2-021 |
| Negotiable | The file layouts are the WIN contract; schedule and eligible states are configuration |
| Valuable | The case shows sent and delivered dates from WIN, not from a phone call |
| Estimable | One outbound job step, two inbound handlers, one daily reconciliation |
| Small | Fits in two weeks with its tests |
| Testable | Each criterion runs against synthetic WIN files |

### 8. Business rules

| ID | Rule | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BR1 | Only notices in a dispatch-eligible state are written to the WIN file; Generated in Epic 1, Approved from RWB-E2-014 | INT-14; JOB-10 |
| BR2 | A notice period starts only from the delivery date on the proof of delivery | CTL-15; R-LIT-07 |
| BR3 | An unacknowledged file is sent again; after the third failure a task goes to the owning team | INT-14 error handling; R-UNI-33, R-UNI-34 |
| BR4 | A `v_ace_pod` row is read only when the ACE batch for source WIN is COMPLETE for its business date; a row with an unknown reference is held | ACE batch record; INT-15 error handling |
| BR5 | A notice sent with no barcode after three days is a reconciliation break | REC-05 |
| BR6 | The same event twice produces one effect and the repeat is counted | R-UNI-40 |
| BR7 | The notice data product is stale one business day after the WIN batch was due | v_ace_batch_status; MSG-P1-001 |

None. This story does not change a case status. It changes the notice state (standard column state):

| From | Event | Condition | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generated | WIN acknowledgment | Barcode returned for the ContractNO | Sent |
| Sent | PROOF_OF_DELIVERY_RECEIVED | Call-back date present | Delivered |

P3 starts the NOTICE_PERIOD timer when it consumes NoticeDelivered (EV-15).

### 12. Contract

**Job JOB-10 WIN outbound notices**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Trigger | Quartz, daily 16:00 Asia/Bangkok |
| Input | Notices in a dispatch-eligible state with no sent date |
| Output | INT-14 file: ContractNO, addressee, address, notice type, template version, document reference; trailer with record count |
| Events published | NoticeDispatched (EV-14) per acknowledged notice |
| Idempotency key | Notice ID and file date; a notice already in an unacknowledged file of the same date is skipped |
| Restart | A failed run is rerun from SCR-44; notices already in a file of that date are not written again |

**Read path: v_ace_pod (ACE ingestion of INT-15)**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Trigger | A daily read at 06:00, after v_ace_batch_status shows source WIN COMPLETE for the business date |
| Input | v_ace_pod rows by notice_ref: barcode, sent_date, callback_date, delivery_status, sent_type, source_system and data_as_of |
| Checks | The ACE batch for source WIN is COMPLETE for the business date; each row matches one notice by barcode, then by notice_ref |
| Output | notice.callback_date, delivery_status and state; ledger entries; held rows on the exception list |
| Events published | NoticeDelivered (EV-15) per newly delivered notice |
| Idempotency key | pod_key and the notice with its callback_date; a repeat is counted under R-UNI-40 |
| Restart | Holds no state; the next read takes the rows of the business date again and changes nothing twice |

**Published interfaces called**

```java
void WinFileGateway.send(OutboundFile file);                                    // P2 integration adapters
void WinAcknowledgmentHandler.onAcknowledgment(WinAckFile ack);               // P6, called by P2 on arrival
UUID InteractionLedgerApi.record(InteractionRecord record);                     // ledger writer, RWB-E1-066
Stream<PodReceipt> RecoveryDataApi.proofOfDelivery(LocalDate businessDate);     // P1, from v_ace_pod by notice_ref
```

### 13. Solution plan

- Package: folder `recovery/comms/dispatch`, Java package `recovery.comms.dispatch`.

| Component | Type | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| WinNoticeFileJob | Job | JOB-10: selects eligible notices, builds and sends the INT-14 file |
| WinNoticeFileWriter | Service | Builds records and trailer to the file specification |
| WinAcknowledgmentHandler | Published interface | Applies the INT-14 acknowledgment: Sent, sent date, barcode, sent type |
| ProofOfDeliveryReader | Service | Reads v_ace_pod for the business date and matches each row to a notice by barcode, then notice_ref |
| DeliveryMatcher | Service | Matches a row by barcode, then notice_ref and sent date |
| NoticeEventPublisher | Service | Writes NoticeDispatched and NoticeDelivered to the outbox |
| BarcodeReconciliation | Job | Daily REC-05 check after the ACE batch is complete |

- Database: table notice gets dispatch_file_id uuid and dispatch_attempts integer default 0 in migration `V1_055__notice_dispatch.sql`; unique index ux_notice_barcode on (barcode) where barcode is not null; index ix_notice_state_sent on (state, sent_date).
- Configuration and reference data: `rwb.comms.dispatch.eligible-states` = GENERATED; `rwb.comms.dispatch.max-attempts` = 3 (INT-14); `rwb.comms.dispatch.barcode-break-days` = 3 (REC-05); `rwb.comms.pod.stale-after-business-days` = 1 (INT-15). Owner of the values: platform administrator through the configuration service.
- Build steps:
  1. Write the migration; test the barcode unique index.
  2. Build WinNoticeFileWriter against the INT-14 file specification; test layout and trailer with 3 synthetic notices.
  3. Build WinNoticeFileJob with the idempotency rule and the retry count; test AC4 and AC8.
  4. Build WinAcknowledgmentHandler with the ledger write and NoticeDispatched; test AC1.
  5. Build ProofOfDeliveryReader over v_ace_pod and DeliveryMatcher with the batch check and NoticeDelivered; test AC2, AC5, AC6, AC7, AC10.
  6. Run the WIN owner's sample file through ACE ingestion as a contract test in SIT; test AC3.
  7. Build BarcodeReconciliation and the stale marker; test AC9 and AC11.
- Feature flag: `rwb.comms.win-dispatch-v1`.
- Done when: the tests in section 16 pass, and the run book for JOB-10 and the proof of delivery read are in the job monitor (RWB-E1-056).

### 17. Guardrails

- No business value in code: schedule, eligible states, attempt limit, break days and stale period are configuration; file layouts follow the interface specification.
- No personal data in logs, tests or prompts. The address is read from `v_ace_contact` only into the outbound file stream and is never logged; the job log holds notice IDs and counts.
- No read of another module's tables. The primary account contract number and the address come through the P1 query; the timer is started by P3 on the event; the delivery is read from `v_ace_pod`.
- Files move only through the integration adapters (REQ-DRI-006); no direct call to WIN.
